" /rmbr let this = (files.s) sub idx.newstate /rmbr let t = HTTP( nameprefix + fullname.fn.this /rmbr, method.s /rmbr, data.this /rmbr, funcname.s /rmbr, newstate),{ never gets here } /rmbr 0.0

Function blocksize:T int 8160

Function blockseqtype:T int getseqtype.toseq.blockseq(1, empty:seq.T)

function sequenceIndex(a:blockseq.T, i:int) T /rmbr assert between(i, 1, n.toseq.a) report" out of bounds " /rmbr let blksz = n.dummy.a /rmbr let blk = getfld(a, (i - 1) / blksz + 2), /rmbr blk sub ((i - 1) mod blksz + 1)

Function _(a:blockseq.T, i:int) T /rmbr assert between(i, 1, n.toseq.a) report" out of bounds " /rmbr let blksz = n.dummy.a /rmbr let blk = getfld(a, (i - 1) / blksz + 2), /rmbr blk sub ((i - 1) mod blksz + 1)

Function blockit3(s:seq.T) seq.T /rmbr let blksz = blocksize:T, /rmbr if n.s ≤ blksz then let newseq = allocatespace(n.s + 2), /rmbr if getseqtype.s = 0 then let discard = blockcopy(newseq, s, n.s + 2), /rmbr bitcast:seq.T(newseq) else for acc = set(set(newseq, 0), n.s), e ∈ s do set(acc, e), /rmbr bitcast:seq.T(newseq) else let noblks = (n.s + blksz - 1) / blksz /rmbr let blockseqtype = getseqtype.toseq.blockseq(1, empty:seq.T)/rmbr let blkseq = allocatespace(noblks + 2), /rmbr for acc = set(set(blkseq, blockseqtype), n.s)/rmbr, @e ∈ arithseq(noblks, blksz, 1) do let newseq = allocatespace(blksz + 2)/rmbr let k = subseq(s, @e, @e + blksz - 1), /rmbr let d = for acc2 = set(set(newseq, 0), n.k), e ∈ k do set(acc2, e), /rmbr acc2, set(acc, newseq), bitcast:seq.T(blkseq)

function blockcopy(p:ptr, b:seq.T, n:int) ptr /rmbr for acc = p, i = 0 /rmbr while i < n /rmbr do next(set(acc, fld:int(toptr.b, i)), i + 1), /rmbr acc

function blockcopy(p:ptr, b:T, n:int) ptr /rmbr{ if n = 3 then set(set(set(p, fld:int(toptr.b, 0)), fld:int(toptr.b, 1)), fld:int(toptr.b, 2))else } /rmbr for acc = p, i = 0 /rmbr while i < n /rmbr do next(set(acc, fld:int(toptr.b, i)), i + 1), /rmbr acc

Function blockit2(s:seq.T, ds:int) seq.T /rmbr assert ds > 1 report" blockit problem " /rmbr let blksz = blocksize:T / ds, /rmbr if n.s ≤ blksz then let newseq = allocatespace(n.s * ds + 2)/rmbr for acc = set(set(newseq, 1), n.s), e ∈ s do blockcopy(acc, e, ds), /rmbr bitcast:seq.T(newseq) else let noblks = (n.s + blksz - 1) / blksz /rmbr let blockseqtype = getseqtype.toseq.blockseq(1, empty:seq.T)/rmbr let blkseq = allocatespace(noblks + 2), /rmbr for acc = set(set(blkseq, blockseqtype), n.s)/rmbr, @e ∈ arithseq(noblks, blksz, 1) do let s2 = subseq(s, @e, @e + blksz - 1)/rmbr let newseq = allocatespace(n.s2 * ds + 2), /rmbr let d = for acc2 = set(set(newseq, 1), n.s2), e ∈ s2 do blockcopy(acc, e, ds), /rmbr acc2, set(acc, newseq), bitcast:seq.T(blkseq)

Module encoding.T

use seq1.seq.encodingpair.T

use indirect.encodingstate.T

use seq.T

use bits

use kernal

use ptr

use word

use seq.word

Export type:encoding.T

Export valueofencoding(encoding.T) int

Export type:encodingstate.T

Export length(encodingstate.T) int

builtin set(ptr, encodingstate.T) ptr

type encoding is valueofencoding:int

Function to:encoding.T(i:int) encoding.T encoding.i

type encodingstate is /rmbr all:seq.encodingpair.T /rmbr, length:int /rmbr, encodetable:seq.seq.encodingpair.T /rmbr, lastadd:encoding.T

Function startInParent:T boolean /rmbr let inst = getinstance3:T, /rmbr if length.fromindirect.state.inst > 0 then false /rmbr else let discard = finishStart:T(encodingnumber.inst), /rmbr true

builtin finishStart:T(eno:int) einfo.T

Function empty:encodingstate.T encodingstate.T /rmbr let e = empty:seq.encodingpair.T, /rmbr encodingstate(e, 0, [e, e, e, e], to:encoding.T(0))

type encodingpair is data:T, code:encoding.T, hash:int

function =(a:encodingpair.T, b:encodingpair.T) boolean /rmbr hash.a = hash.b /rmbr ∧ valueofencoding.code.a = valueofencoding.code.b /rmbr ∧ data.a = data.b

unbound hash(T) int

unbound =(T, T) boolean

Function lastadded(h:encodingstate.T) encoding.T code.(all.h) sub n.all.h

function notsamehash:T(a:int, b:int, mask:bits) boolean /rmbr(bits.a ∧ mask) ≠ (bits.b ∧ mask)

builtin deepcopy(T) T

Function addencoding(h:encodingstate.T, data:T) encodingstate.T /rmbr{ this is the add that is called by primitiveadd } /rmbr let datav = deepcopy.data /rmbr let hashv = hash.datav /rmbr let tablesize = n.encodetable.h /rmbr let mask = bits.-1 >> (64 - floorLog2.tablesize)/rmbr let dataindex = toint( tobits.hashv ∧ mask)/rmbr + 1 let existingcode = lookuprep2(datav, (encodetable.h) sub dataindex), /rmbr if not. isempty.existingcode then{ already present } /rmbr let c = code.existingcode sub 1, /rmbr if lastadd.h = c then h else encodingstate(all.h, length.h, encodetable.h, c) else let code = to:encoding.T(n.all.h + 1)/rmbr let p = encodingpair(datav, code, hashv)/rmbr let codeindex = toint( tobits.valueofencoding.code ∧ mask)/rmbr + 1 for listencode = [p], e ∈ (encodetable.h) sub dataindex /rmbr do if data.e = data.p ∨ notsamehash:T(hash.p, hash.e, mask) then listencode /rmbr else listencode + e let etable = encodetable.h /rmbr let newencode = replace(encodetable.h, dataindex, listencode), /rmbr{ subseq(etable, 1, dataindex-1)+listencode+subseq(etable, dataindex+1, n.etable) } /rmbr if 3 * length.h > 2 * tablesize then encodingstate( all.h + p /rmbr, length.h + 1 /rmbr, newencode + newencode + newencode + newencode /rmbr, code.p) else encodingstate(all.h + p, length.h + 1, newencode, code.p)

Function addencodings(l:seq.T) int /rmbr let inst = getinstance3:T /rmbr for acc = to:encoding.T(0), @e ∈ l do primitiveadd(inst, @e), /rmbr 0

Function decode(t:encoding.T) T /rmbr let h = encodingstate.getinstance3:T /rmbr assert between(valueofencoding.t, 1, n.all.h) report" no such encoding " + toword.valueofencoding.t + stacktrace, /rmbr data.(all.h) sub valueofencoding.t

type einfo is state:indirect.encodingstate.T, encodingnumber:int, allocatein:ptr

function encodingstate(e:einfo.T) encodingstate.T fromindirect.state.e

builtin getinstance3:T einfo.T

Function add1encoding(p:ptr, data:T) encoding.T /rmbr{ ptr is used instead of einfo since einfo is also defined in encodingsupport } /rmbr let t = addencoding(fromindirect.state.bitcast2:einfo.T(p), data)/rmbr let discard = set(p, t), /rmbr lastadd.t

builtin bitcast2:einfo.T(ptr) einfo.T

builtin primitiveadd(e:einfo.T, s:T) encoding.T

type e3 is sequence, data:seq.encodingpair.T

function sequenceIndex(a:e3.T, i:int) T data.(data.a) sub i

Function encodingdata:T seq.T /rmbr let t = all. encodingstate.getinstance3:T, /rmbr toseq.e3(n.t, t)

Function encode(t:T) encoding.T /rmbr let instance = getinstance3:T /rmbr let r = lookuprep(t, encodingstate.instance), if isempty.r then primitiveadd(instance, t) /rmbr else code.r sub 1

Function =(a:encoding.T, b:encoding.T) boolean valueofencoding.a = valueofencoding.b

Function >1(a:encoding.T, b:encoding.T) ordering valueofencoding.a >1 valueofencoding.b

Function hash(a:encoding.T) int valueofencoding.a

function lookuprep(t:T, inst:encodingstate.T) seq.encodingpair.T /rmbr let mask = bits.-1 >> (64 - floorLog2.n.encodetable.inst)/rmbr let dataindex = toint( tobits. hash.t ∧ mask)/rmbr + 1, lookuprep2(t, (encodetable.inst) sub dataindex)

function lookuprep2(t:T, s:seq.encodingpair.T) seq.encodingpair.T /rmbr for acc = empty:seq.encodingpair.T, e ∈ s /rmbr do if t = data.e then acc + e else acc, /rmbr acc

Function findencode(t:T) seq.T /rmbr let r = lookuprep(t, encodingstate.getinstance3:T), if isempty.r then empty:seq.T else[data.r sub 1]

Function addorder(t:T) int valueofencoding. encode.t

function analyze(t:encodingstate.T) seq.word /rmbr" numele = " /rmbr + toword.n.all.t /rmbr + " encodecounts " /rmbr + counts(encodetable.t, 1, 0, 0, 0)

function counts(s:seq.seq.encodingpair.T, i:int, one:int, two:int, big:int) seq.word /rmbr if i > n.s then for acc = "" , @e ∈ [n.s, one, two, big] /rmbr do acc + toword.@e, /rmbr acc else let t = n.s sub i, /rmbr if t = 0 then counts(s, i + 1, one, two, big) /rmbr else if t = 1 then counts(s, i + 1, one + 1, two, big) /rmbr else if t = 2 then counts(s, i + 1, one, two + 1, big) /rmbr else counts(s, i + 1, one, two, big + 1)

Function txt2html:T(z:seq.seq.word, classes:seq.classinfo, xhtml:boolean) seq.word /rmbr{ covert paragraph to html } /rmbr let replacements = asset.classes /rmbr let gdefatt = lookupkey(replacements, " /global$defs " sub 1)/rmbr let globaldefs = if isempty.gdefatt then "" else def.gdefatt sub 1 let pdef = def. lookupkey(replacements, " /p " sub 1)/rmbr sub 1 for acc0 = "" /rmbr, mark0 = push( push(newmarks, mark( " block " sub 1, n.newacc))/rmbr, newacc) else let r = lookupkey(replacements, e), /rmbr if isempty.r then next(pidx + 1, skip, defines, marks, acc + e)/rmbr else let att = r sub 1 /rmbr let basedon = baseon.att, /rmbr if isnamedmark.att ∧ key.att = tag.att then{ marks beginning of tag } /rmbr next( pidx + 1 /rmbr, skip /rmbr, defines /rmbr, push(marks, mark(basedon, marks /rmbr while kind. top.marks1 ∈ " block /li " ∧ place. top.marks1 = n.acc1 /rmbr do pop.marks1, /rmbr marks1 else if basedon ∈ " /td " ∧ kind. top.marks ∈ " /th " then push( pop.marks, top.marks ∈ " block " then pop.marks else marks, /rmbr if kind. top.stkt ∈ " /tr " then pop.stkt else stkt else marks let lastplace = if basedon ∈ " /head " then 0 /rmbr else if isnocontent.att then n.acc1 /rmbr else place. top.marks1 let smallacc = subseq(acc1, 1, lastplace)/rmbr let content = subseq(acc1, lastplace + 1, n.acc1)/rmbr let combinedDef = defines + def.att + globaldefs /rmbr let new /rmbr else if basedon ∈ " /caption " ∧ kind. top.marks1 ∈ " mark " then pop.marks /rmbr else marks1, let stk2 = if basedon ∈ " /tr /td /th /li " then push(stk7, mark(basedon, n.new)) /rmbr else if function evaldef:T(/rmbr defs:seq.word /rmbr, content:seq.word /rmbr, xhtml:boolean /rmbr, raw:seq.seq.word /rmbr, pidx:int /rmbr) seq.word /rmbr let alldefs = getDefines.defs /rmbr for acc = "" , e ∈ getToHTMLexpression.alldefs /rmbr do acc /rmbr + ( if name.e = " no eval " then value.e /rmbr else{ now evaluate exp and assign result to value } /rmbr for stk = empty:stack.seq.word, state = 0, ele ∈ value.e /rmbr do if ele ∈ " ' " then next(stk, 1) /rmbr else if ele ∈ " /nsp /sp " ∨ state = 1 then next( push(stk, [ele]), 0)/rmbr else if ele ∈ " content " then next( push(stk, content), 0) /rmbr else if ele ∈ " colon " then next( push(stk, " : " ), 0) /rmbr else if ele ∈ " /post /pre " then{ designed to add directory and extension to file names } /rmbr assert n.toseq.stk > 1 report" XXX B " /rmbr let second = top.stk /rmbr let first = top. pop.stk, /rmbr let val = if ele ∈ " pre " then if isempty.second /rmbr ∨ first << (n.first - n.second) = second /rmbr ∨ second sub 1 ∈ first then first /rmbr else first + second else{ post } /rmbr if isempty.first then second /rmbr else if first << (n.first - n.second) = second then first /rmbr else first + second, next( push( pop(stk, 2), val), state) else if ele ∈ " /raw " then{ extract original input for last format command } /rmbr let endtag = merge. " / :( subseq( last.raw, pidx, pidx))" let raw2 = raw >> 1 /rmbr + subseq( last.raw, 1, pidx - 1), for txt = "" , quit = false, p0 ∈ reverse.raw2 /rmbr while not.quit /rmbr do for i2 = n.p0, w ∈ reverse.p0 /rmbr while i2 > 0 ∧ w ≠ endtag /rmbr do i2 - 1, /rmbr if i2 > 0 then next(p0 << i2 + txt, true) /rmbr else next(p0 + txt, false), next( push(stk, txt), state) else if ele ∈ " /escape/ " then{ if word begins with / then remove / from word and use nospace format to recombine } /rmbr for acc2 = "" , w ∈ top.stk /rmbr do let t = decodeword.w, /rmbr if n.t > 1 /rmbr ∧ t sub 1 = char1. " / " then acc2 + encodeword(t + char.32)/rmbr else acc2 + w, next( push( pop.stk, acc2), state) else let result = dawsextensions:T(ele, stk), /rmbr if not. isempty.result then next(result, state)/rmbr else let value = extractdef(alldefs, [ele])/rmbr let newstk = push(stk, value), /rmbr next(newstk, state) let value = %.toseq.stk, /rmbr if isempty.name.e then value /rmbr else attribute(value, name.e) ), acc

Module classinfo

precedence > for >1 >2

use UTF8

use bits

use seq.char

use seq.classinfo

use set.classinfo

use sort.classinfo

use seq.mark

use stack.mark

use seq1.pair

use standard

use seq.word

Export type:classinfo

Export type:tagorder

Export key(classinfo) word

Export baseon(classinfo) word

Export def(classinfo) seq.word

Export tag(classinfo) word

Export toseq(tagorder) seq.classinfo

type classinfo is key:word, baseon:word, def:seq.word, tag:word, flags:bits

type tagorder is toseq:seq.classinfo

The set.classinfo will be ordered by key. The taginfo will be ordered by tag.

Function totagorder(a:seq.classinfo) tagorder /rmbr tagorder. sort>3.a

Function lookuptag(lst:set.classinfo, tag:word) seq.classinfo /rmbr lookuptag( totagorder.toseq.lst, tag)

Function lookupkey(lst:set.classinfo, key:word) seq.classinfo /rmbr toseq. lookup(lst, classinfo(key, key, "" , key, tobits.0))

Function lookuptag(s:tagorder, tag:word) seq.classinfo /rmbr let j = binarysearch>3(toseq.s, classinfo(tag, tag, "" , tag, tobits.0)), if j < 0 then empty:seq.classinfo /rmbr else for low = j, high = j, up = true, down = true /rmbr while up ∨ down /rmbr do let newdown = low > 1 ∧ tag = tag.(toseq.s) sub (low - 1) let newup = high < n.toseq.s ∧ tag = tag.(toseq.s) sub (high + 1) let newlow = if newdown then low - 1 else low, /rmbr let newhigh = if newup then high + 1 else high, /rmbr next(newlow, newhigh, newup, newdown), subseq(toseq.s, low, high)

Function %(a:classinfo) seq.word escapeFormat([key.a, baseon.a, tag.a] + def.a)

Function >1(a:classinfo, b:classinfo) ordering key.a >1 key.b

function >3(a:classinfo, b:classinfo) ordering tag.a >1 tag.b

function =(a:classinfo, b:classinfo) boolean key.a = key.b

Function tokey(w:word) word /rmbr let a = decodeword.w, /rmbr if a sub 2 = char1. " / " then w /rmbr else encodeword( [ char1. " / " ]/rmbr + decodeword.w << 1)

Function classinfo2(/rmbr base:set.classinfo /rmbr, ele:word /rmbr, class:word /rmbr, more:seq.word /rmbr) seq.classinfo /rmbr let flagdefs = extractdef(more, " flags " sub 1)/rmbr for flags = tobits.0, w ∈ flagdefs /rmbr do let str = " mark noendtag define namedmark nocontent " /rmbr let i = findindex(str, w), /rmbr if i > n.str then flags else flags ∨ tobits.2 sup i, if class ∈ " daws " ∨ class = ele then let key = merge( " / " + ele)/rmbr let tag = merge( " < " + ele)/rmbr let more1 = if subseq(more, 1, 2) = " flags: " then let i = min( findindex(more << 2, " : " sub 1)/rmbr, findindex(more << 2, " : " sub 1) ), if i + 2 > n.more then "" else more << i else more, let a = classinfo(key, key, more1, tag, flags), /rmbr if isdefine.a then[classinfo(key, key, more1, key, flags)]/rmbr else if noendtag.a then [a] /rmbr else let endtag = encodeword( [ char1. " < " , char1. " / " ]/rmbr + decodeword.ele /rmbr + char1. " > " ) let namedtag = merge( " // " + ele), /rmbr if ismark.a then[a, classinfo(endtag, tag, "" , endtag, flags ∨ tobits.1)]/rmbr else if isnamedmark.a then[ a /rmbr, classinfo(endtag, tag, "" , endtag, tobits.1)/rmbr, classinfo(namedtag, key, "" , namedtag, tobits.16) ] else[a, classinfo(endtag, tag, "" , endtag, tobits.1)] else let key = merge( " / " + class)/rmbr let basekey = merge( " / " + ele)/rmbr let info2 = lookupkey(base, basekey)/rmbr assert not. isempty.info2 report escapeFormat( " no base class key basekey: " + basekey + " key: " + key + " ele: " + ele)/rmbr let baseclass = info2 sub 1 /rmbr for newdefs = " class " , last = " ? " , e ∈ more /rmbr do next( if e ∈ " : " then newdefs + last else newdefs, [e])/rmbr{ newdefs is a list of definitions included in the new class definition } /rmbr for skip = false, basedefs = "" , last1 = "" , e ∈ def.baseclass + " dummy: " /rmbr do if e ∉ " : " then next(skip, if skip then basedefs else basedefs + last1, [e]) /rmbr else if not. isempty.last1 /rmbr ∧ last1 sub 1 ∈ newdefs then next(true, basedefs, "" )/rmbr else next(false, basedefs + last1, [e]) { basedefs >> 1 is a list of definitions included in base but not in the new definition } /rmbr let y = classinfo( key /rmbr, { basekey } baseon.baseclass /rmbr, " class: " + class + more + basedefs >> 1 /rmbr, tag.baseclass /rmbr, if isempty.flagdefs then flags.baseclass else flags), if isnamedmark.y then let namedtag = merge( " // " + class), /rmbr[ y /rmbr, classinfo(namedtag, { basekey } baseon.baseclass, "" , namedtag, tobits.16) ] else[y]

Function isendtag(a:classinfo) boolean /rmbr(flags.a ∧ bits.1) = bits.1

Function ismark(a:classinfo) boolean /rmbr(flags.a ∧ bits.2) = bits.2

Function noendtag(a:classinfo) boolean /rmbr(flags.a ∧ bits.4) = bits.4

Function isdefine(a:classinfo) boolean /rmbr(flags.a ∧ bits.8) = bits.8

Function isnamedmark(a:classinfo) boolean /rmbr(flags.a ∧ bits.16) = bits.16

Function isnocontent(a:classinfo) boolean /rmbr(flags.a ∧ bits.32) = bits.32

Function print(t:seq.classinfo) seq.word /rmbr for acc = "" , e ∈ t /rmbr do if isendtag.e then acc /rmbr else let flags = ( if ismark.e then " mark " else"" )/rmbr + ( if noendtag.e then " noendtag " else"" )/rmbr + ( if isdefine.e then " define " else"" )/rmbr + ( if isnamedmark.e then " namedmark " else"" )/rmbr + ( if isnocontent.e then " nocontent " else"" ) let flags1 = if isempty.flags then "" else" flags: :(flags)" , let class = extractdef(def.e, " class " sub 1), /rmbr acc /rmbr + ":( encodeword( decodeword.baseon.e << 1)) . :(( if isempty.class then " daws " else class)) {/* daws :(flags1):( escapeFormat.def.e) */} " /rmbr + " /br " , acc

Function extractdef(defs:seq.word, name:word) seq.word /rmbr for notdone = true, found = false, acc = "" , e ∈ defs + " dummy: " /rmbr while notdone /rmbr do if found then if e ∈ " : " then next(false, found, acc >> 1) else next(notdone, found, acc + e)/rmbr else if e = name then next(notdone, found, [e]) /rmbr else if e ∈ " : " then if name ∈ subseq(acc, 1, 1) then { found } next(notdone, true, "" ) /rmbr else next(notdone, found, " : " ) else next(notdone, found, [e]), if not.found then "" else acc

Function processCSS(z:seq.seq.word, dd:seq.classinfo) seq.classinfo /rmbr for acc = dd, p ∈ z /rmbr do for acc1 = acc /rmbr, idx = findindex(p, " { " sub 1) while idx ≤ n.p /rmbr do let more = if subseq(p, idx + 1, idx + 2)/rmbr = " /* daws " then subseq( p /rmbr, idx + 3 /rmbr, idx + findindex(p << idx, " */ " sub 1) - 1) else"" let new = if (idx = 2 /rmbr ∨ p sub (idx - 2) ∈ " }/br " )/rmbr ∧ not. isempty.more then classinfo2( asset.acc1 /rmbr, { ele } p sub (idx - 1)/rmbr, { class } p sub (idx - 1)/rmbr, more)/rmbr + acc1 else if idx > n.p /rmbr ∨ idx < 4 /rmbr ∨ p sub (idx - 2) ∉ " . " /rmbr ∨ p sub (idx - 3) ∈ " }*/ " then acc1 /rmbr else assert p sub (idx - 1) ∉ " daws " /rmbr ∨ subseq(p, idx + 1, idx + 2)/rmbr = " /* daws " report" In css file when defining how a new element: " /rmbr + " (subseq(p, idx-3, idx), daws requires instructions in a comment of form: /* daws... */ " , classinfo2( asset.acc1 /rmbr, { ele } p sub (idx - 3)/rmbr, { class } p sub (idx - 1)/rmbr, more)/rmbr + acc1, next(new, idx + findindex(p << idx, " { " sub 1)), acc1, acc

Function defaults seq.classinfo /rmbr let data = " q{/* daws flags: mark tohtml: < q class id > content </ q > totxt: content /mark id /id class */} :( $$) b{/* daws flags: mark tohtml: < b class id > content </ b > totxt: content /mark id /id class */} :( $$) i{/* daws flags: mark tohtml: < i class id > content </ i > totxt: content /mark id /id class */} :( $$) em{/* daws flags: mark tohtml: < em class id > content </ em > totxt: content /mark id /id class */} :( $$) strong{/* daws flags: mark tohtml: < strong class id > content </ strong > totxt: content /mark id /id class */} :( $$) span{/* daws flags: mark tohtml: < span class id > content </ span > totxt: content /mark id /id class */} :( $$) span.spc{/* daws flags: mark tohtml: /sp < span class id > content </ span > /sp */} :( $$) caption{/* daws flags: namedmark tohtml: < caption class id > content </ caption > totxt: content class */} :( $$) a{/* daws flags: mark tohtml: < a class id href > content </ a > totxt: content /mark href /href class */} :( $$) sub{/* daws flags: mark tohtml: /nsp < sub class id > content </ sub > totxt: content /mark id /id class */} :( $$) sup{/* daws flags: mark tohtml: /nsp < sup class id > function place(r:thisresult) int i. top.stk.r

type frame is Sstate:state, Fstate:state, i:int, result:seq.seq.byte, faili:int, failresult:seq.seq.byte

type thisresult is stk:stack.frame

Function status(a:thisresult) word /rmbr if Sstate. top.stk.a ≠ Match then 'Failed /rmbr else if place.a = { length of input } faili. top.stk.a then 'Match /rmbr else 'MatchPrefix

Function result(a:thisresult) seq.byte /rmbr last.result. top.stk.a

function parse(myinput0:seq.word, initAttr:seq.byte, textOut:boolean) thisresult /rmbr let myinput = packed(myinput0 + endMark)/rmbr let packedTable = packed. mytable /rmbr for stk = empty:stack.frame /rmbr, state = startstate /rmbr, i = 1 /rmbr, inputi = myinput sub 1 /rmbr, result = [initAttr]/rmbr, faili = 1 /rmbr, failresult = [initAttr] while toint.state > toint. Match /rmbr do let actionState = action.state, /rmbr if actionState = Fail then{ goto Fstate.top.stk, i = faili.top, pop.stk, discard result } /rmbr let top = top.stk, /rmbr if toint. action.Fstate.top ≥ toint. S' then let newi = i.top, /rmbr next( pop.stk /rmbr, nextState.Fstate.top /rmbr, newi /rmbr, idxNB(myinput, newi)/rmbr, result.top /rmbr, faili.top /rmbr, failresult.top) else next( pop.stk /rmbr, Fstate.top /rmbr, faili.top /rmbr, idxNB(myinput, faili.top)/rmbr, failresult.top /rmbr, faili.top /rmbr, failresult.top) else if actionState = Success* then{ goto Sstate.top.stk, pop.stk, keep result } /rmbr let top = top.stk, /rmbr next( pop.stk, Sstate.top, i, inputi, result.top + result, faili.top, failresult.top) else if actionState = Discard* then let top = top.stk, /rmbr next( stk /rmbr, nextState.state /rmbr, i /rmbr, inputi /rmbr, result.top /rmbr, i /rmbr, result.top) else if actionState = All then let top = top.stk /rmbr let att = [ toAttribute(result sub n.result, subseq(myinput, i.top, i - 1))], next( pop.stk, Sstate.top, i, inputi, result.top + att, faili.top, failresult.top) else if actionState = Lambda then let att = [ action( reduceNo.state, result, textOut)], /rmbr next( stk /rmbr, nextState2.state /rmbr, i /rmbr, inputi /rmbr, result + att /rmbr, faili /rmbr, failresult) else if actionState = Reduce then let top = top.stk /rmbr let att = [ action( reduceNo.state, result, textOut)], /rmbr next( pop.stk, Sstate.top, i, inputi, result.top + att, faili.top, failresult.top) else if actionState = Reduce* then let att = [ action( reduceNo.state, result, textOut)]/rmbr let top = top.stk, /rmbr next(stk, nextState.state, i, inputi, att, i, att) else if actionState = !Reduce then let top = top.stk /rmbr let ini = idxNB(myinput, faili.top), /rmbr next( pop.stk, Fstate.top, faili.top, ini, failresult.top, faili.top, failresult.top) else if actionState = !Fail then let top = top.stk /rmbr let ini = idxNB(myinput, i.top), /rmbr next( pop.stk, Sstate.top, i.top, ini, result.top, faili.top, failresult.top) else if actionState = T then let te = idxNB(packedTable, index.state), /rmbr if inputi ≠ match.te then{ fail } next(stk, Fstate.te, faili, idxNB(myinput, faili), failresult, faili, failresult)/rmbr else next(stk, Sstate.te, i + 1, idxNB(myinput, i + 1), result, faili, failresult) else if actionState = !T then let te = idxNB(packedTable, index.state), /rmbr if inputi = match.te then{ fail } next(stk, Sstate.te, faili, idxNB(myinput, faili), failresult, faili, failresult)/rmbr else next(stk, Fstate.te, i, inputi, result, faili, failresult) else if actionState = MatchAny then let te = idxNB(packedTable, index.state), /rmbr if inputi = endMark then{ fail } next(stk, Fstate.te, i, inputi, result, faili, failresult)/rmbr else let reslt = result + toAttribute(result sub n.result, [inputi]) let ini = idxNB(myinput, i + 1), /rmbr next(stk, Sstate.te, i + 1, ini, reslt, faili, failresult) else if actionState = T' then let te = idxNB(packedTable, index.state), /rmbr if inputi = match.te then next(stk, Sstate.te, i + 1, idxNB(myinput, i + 1), result, faili, failresult)/rmbr else next(stk, Fstate.te, i, inputi, result, faili, failresult) else{ match non Terminal } /rmbr let te = idxNB(packedTable, index.state)/rmbr assert action.action.te ∈ [ NT, NT*] report" PROBLEM PEG :(state)" /rmbr let newstk = push(stk, frame(Sstate.te, Fstate.te, i, result, faili, failresult)), /rmbr let tmp = [ toAttribute(result sub n.result, empty:seq.word)], next(newstk, nextState.action.te, i, inputi, tmp, i, tmp), thisresult.push(stk, frame(state, state, i, result, n.myinput, result))

Module graph.T

use set.<<.T

use seq.barc.T

use set.barc.T

use set.T

use standard

unbound tail(T) <<.T

unbound head(T) <<.T

unbound toarc(<<.T) T

unbound >1(<<.T, <<.T) ordering

Export head(T) <<.T

Function >1(a:T, b:T) ordering /rmbr tail.a >1 tail.b /rmbr ∧ head.a >1 head.b

Function >2(a:T, b:T) ordering /rmbr tail.a >1 tail.b

type << is dummy:T

type barc is arc:T

Function head(b:barc.T) <<.T tail.arc.b

Function tail(b:barc.T) <<.T head.arc.b

Function >1(a:barc.T, b:barc.T) ordering /rmbr tail.a >1 tail.b /rmbr ∧ head.a >1 head.b

Function >2(a:barc.T, b:barc.T) ordering /rmbr tail.a >1 tail.b

Function tobarc(s:seq.T) seq.barc.T /rmbr for acc = empty:seq.barc.T, e ∈ s do acc + barc.e, /rmbr acc

Function toarcs(s:seq.barc.T) seq.T /rmbr for acc = empty:seq.T, e ∈ s do acc + arc.e, /rmbr acc

type graph is arcs:set.T, backarcs:set.barc.T, nodes:set.<<.T

Export nodes(graph.T) set.<<.T

Export arcs(graph.T) set.T

Export type:graph.T

/Export type:barc.T

/Export type:<<.T

Function newgraph(arcs:seq.T) graph.T /rmbr for acc = empty:set.<<.T, e ∈ arcs /rmbr do acc + tail.e + head.e, /rmbr graph( asset.arcs /rmbr, asset. tobarc.arcs /rmbr, acc)

Function arcstosuccessors(g:graph.T, n:<<.T) set.T /rmbr findelement2(arcs.g, toarc.n)

Function successors(g:graph.T, n:<<.T) set.<<.T /rmbr for acc = empty:set.<<.T /rmbr, @e ∈ toseq. findelement2(arcs.g, toarc.n) do acc + head.@e, /rmbr acc

Function arcstopredecessors(g:graph.T, n:<<.T) seq.T /rmbr toarcs.toseq. findelement2(backarcs.g, barc. toarc.n)

Function predecessors(g:graph.T, n:<<.T) set.<<.T /rmbr for acc = empty:set.<<.T /rmbr, e ∈ toseq. findelement2(backarcs.g, barc. toarc.n) do acc + head.e, /rmbr acc

Function replacearcs(g:graph.T, oldarcs:set.T, newarcs:set.T) graph.T /rmbr deletearcs(g, oldarcs \ newarcs)/rmbr + toseq(newarcs \ oldarcs)

Function deletearc(g:graph.T, a:T) graph.T /rmbr graph(arcs.g - a, backarcs.g - barc.a, nodes.g)

Function deletearcs(g:graph.T, a:set.T) graph.T /rmbr for acc = g, e ∈ toseq.a do deletearc(acc, e), /rmbr acc

Function+(g:graph.T, nodes:seq.<<.T) graph.T /rmbr graph(arcs.g, backarcs.g, asset.nodes ∪ nodes.g)

Function+(g:graph.T, a:T) graph.T /rmbr graph( arcs.g + a /rmbr, backarcs.g + barc.a /rmbr, nodes.g + tail.a + head.a)

Function+(g:graph.T, a:seq.T) graph.T /rmbr for acc = g, @e ∈ a do acc + @e, /rmbr acc

Function deletenode(g:graph.T, n:<<.T) graph.T /rmbr deletearcs( graph(arcs.g, backarcs.g, nodes.g - n)/rmbr, arcstosuccessors(g, n)/rmbr ∪ asset. arcstopredecessors(g, n) )

Function sinks(g:graph.T, b:set.<<.T) seq.<<.T /rmbr{ returns list of sinks in graph with arcs to nodes in set b removed } /rmbr for acc = empty:seq.<<.T, n ∈ toseq(nodes.g \ b) /rmbr do if n( successors(g, n) \ b)/rmbr = 0 then acc + n /rmbr else acc, acc

Function sources(g:graph.T, b:set.<<.T) seq.<<.T /rmbr{ returns list of sources in graph with arcs to nodes in set b removed } /rmbr for acc = empty:seq.<<.T, n ∈ toseq(nodes.g \ b) /rmbr do if n( predecessors(g, n) \ b)/rmbr = 0 then acc + n /rmbr else acc, acc

Function sources(g:graph.T) seq.<<.T /rmbr sources(g, empty:set.<<.T)

Function sinks(g:graph.T) seq.<<.T /rmbr sinks(g, empty:set.<<.T)

Function subgraph(g:graph.T, nodes:set.<<.T) graph.T /rmbr for acc = graph( empty:set.T /rmbr, empty:set.barc.T /rmbr, nodes)/rmbr, e ∈ toseq.arcs.g do if head.e ∉ nodes then acc /rmbr else if tail.e ∉ nodes then acc /rmbr else acc + e, acc

Function reachable(g:graph.T, a:seq.<<.T) set.<<.T /rmbr let d = asset.a, /rmbr reachable(g, d, d, 1)

function reachable(g:graph.T, old:set.<<.T, new:set.<<.T, count:int) set.<<.T /rmbr assert count < 1000 report" fal " /rmbr + toword. n.old /rmbr + toword. n.new, if isempty.new then old /rmbr else for acc = empty:set.<<.T, e ∈ toseq.new /rmbr do acc ∪ successors(g, e)/rmbr let b = old ∪ new, /rmbr reachable(g, b, acc \ b, count + 1)

Function complement(g:graph.T) graph.T /rmbr for acc = empty:set.T, a ∈ toseq.arcs.g /rmbr do acc + reverse.a, /rmbr graph( acc /rmbr, asset. tobarc.toseq.acc /rmbr, nodes.g)

unbound reverse(T) T

-------------------------------

Function outdegree(g:graph.T, n:<<.T) int n. successors(g, n)

Function indegree(g:graph.T, n:<<.T) int n. predecessors(g, n)

Function =(a:graph.T, b:graph.T) boolean /rmbr n.arcs.a = n.arcs.b /rmbr ∧ nodes.a = nodes.b /rmbr ∧ arcs.a = arcs.b

Function transitiveClosure(gin:graph.T) graph.T /rmbr{ add arcs to graph so if node is reachable, it can be reached with single arc } /rmbr for g = gin, n ∈ toseq.nodes.gin /rmbr do{ add arcs to graph so path does not need to go through n } /rmbr for arcs = empty:seq.T /rmbr, p ∈ arcstopredecessors(g, n) do for acc2 = empty:seq.T /rmbr, s ∈ toseq. arcstosuccessors(g, n) do acc2 + merge(p, s), /rmbr arcs + acc2, g + arcs, g

unbound merge(T, T) T

Module arc.T

Function merge(p:arc.T, s:arc.T) arc.T arc(tail.p, head.s)

Builtin aborted(process.T) boolean

Function message(p:process.T) seq.word /rmbr if aborted.p then if isempty.msg.p then let h = toseqbyte.header.p, /rmbr towords.UTF8. subseq(h, 1, findindex(h, tobyte.10)) else msg.p else" normal exit "

Function result(p:process.T) T /rmbr assert not.aborted.p report" no result of aborted process " , /rmbr(body1.p) sub 1

Function sup(a:real, n:int) real /rmbr if n = 0 then 1.0 /rmbr else if n = 1 then a /rmbr else if n < 0 then 1.0 / a sup -n /rmbr else let d = n / 2, /rmbr a sup d * a sup (n - d)

Function *(a:int, b:real) real toreal.a * b

Function makereal(w:seq.word) real /rmbr reallit( for acc = empty:seq.char, @e ∈ w /rmbr do acc + decodeword.@e, /rmbr acc /rmbr, -1 /rmbr, 1 /rmbr, 0 /rmbr, 1)

Function isNaN(r:real) boolean /rmbr representation.r /rmbr = representation. NaN

Function %(decimalPlaces:int, rin1:real) seq.word /rmbr{ converts rin1 to text form with specified number no decimal places. } /rmbr if isNaN.rin1 then " NaN " /rmbr else let neg = rin1 >1 toreal.0 = LT /rmbr let rin = if neg then toreal.0 - rin1 else rin1 /rmbr let a = 10 sup decimalPlaces /rmbr let r = rin + 1.0 / toreal(a * 2), /rmbr let r2 = if decimalPlaces > 0 then[ toword. intpart.r /rmbr, " . " sub 1 /rmbr, encodeword. lpad( decimalPlaces /rmbr, char.48 /rmbr, decodeUTF8. toUTF8. intpart( (r - toreal. intpart.r)/rmbr * toreal.a) ) ] else[ toword. intpart.r], if neg then " - :(r2)" else r2

Function toUTF8(rin1:real, decimals:int) UTF8 /rmbr let neg = rin1 >1 toreal.0 = LT /rmbr let rin = if neg then toreal.0 - rin1 else rin1 /rmbr let a = 10 sup decimals /rmbr let r = rin + 1.0 / toreal(a * 2)/rmbr let r2 = if decimals > 0 then toUTF8. intpart.r /rmbr + encodeUTF8. periodchar /rmbr + UTF8. lpad( decimals /rmbr, tobyte.48 /rmbr, toseqbyte. toUTF8. intpart( (r - toreal. intpart.r)/rmbr * toreal.a) ) else toUTF8. intpart.r, if neg ∧ rin1 ≠ 0.0 then encodeUTF8. hyphenchar + r2 /rmbr else r2

Function reallit(s:UTF8) real /rmbr reallit( decodeUTF8.s, -1, 1, 0, 1)

function reallit(s:seq.char, decimals:int, i:int, val:int, neg:int) real /rmbr if i > n.s then let r = if decimals < 1 then toreal.val /rmbr else toreal.val / toreal.decimals, if neg < 1 then -1.0 * r else r else if between(toint.s sub i, 48, 57) then reallit( s /rmbr, if decimals = -1 then -1 else decimals * 10 /rmbr, i + 1 /rmbr, 10 * val + toint.s sub i - 48 /rmbr, neg) else if s sub i = char.32 /rmbr ∨ s sub i = commachar then reallit(s, decimals, i + 1, val, neg)/rmbr else if i < 3 /rmbr ∧ s sub i = hyphenchar then reallit(s, decimals, i + 1, val, -1)/rmbr else if i < 3 /rmbr ∧ s sub i = char1. " + " then reallit(s, decimals, i + 1, val, 1)/rmbr else assert s sub i = periodchar report" unexpected character in real literal " + encodeword.s, /rmbr reallit(s, 1, i + 1, val, neg)

Function seqseg(sin:seq.T, ii:int) pseq.T /rmbr let s = to:pseq.T(sin), /rmbr if n.toseq.s = 0 then pseq(n.sin + 1, sin, empty:seq.T, ii - 1)/rmbr else let i = ii + start.s /rmbr let len = n.a.s, /rmbr if i > len then let x = to:pseq.T(b.s), /rmbr if n.toseq.x = 0 then pseq( n.b.s - i + len + 1 /rmbr, b.s /rmbr, empty:seq.T /rmbr, i - len - 1) else seqseg(b.s, i - len) else let x = to:pseq.T(a.s), /rmbr if n.toseq.x = 0 then pseq(n.a.s - i + 1, a.s, empty:seq.T, i - 1)/rmbr else seqseg(a.s, i)

function sequenceIndex(s:pseq.T, ii:int) T /rmbr let i = ii + start.s /rmbr let len = n.a.s, /rmbr if i > len then let x = to:pseq.T(b.s), /rmbr if n.toseq.x = 0 then idxNB(b.s, i - len) else sequenceIndex(x, i - len) else let x = to:pseq.T(a.s), /rmbr if n.toseq.x = 0 then idxNB(a.s, i) else sequenceIndex(x, i)

Function+(a:seq.T, b:seq.T) seq.T /rmbr{ OPTION NOINLINE } /rmbr let la = n.a, /rmbr if n.a = 0 then b /rmbr else let lb = n.b, /rmbr if lb = 0 then a else catnonzero(a, b)

function cat3(totallength:int, a:seq.T, b:seq.T, c:seq.T) seq.T /rmbr if n.a > n.b then toseq.pseq(totallength, a, catnonzero(b, c), 0) /rmbr else if n.b < n.c then toseq.pseq(totallength, catnonzero(a, b), c, 0) /rmbr else toseq.pseq(totallength, toseq.pseq(n.a + n.b, a, b, 0), c, 0)

function catnonzero(a:seq.T, b:seq.T) seq.T /rmbr let totallength = n.a + n.b, /rmbr if totallength = 2 then [idxNB(a, 1), idxNB(b, 1)] /rmbr else let ta = to:pseq.T(a), /rmbr if n.toseq.ta = 0 then let tb = to:pseq.T(b), /rmbr if n.toseq.tb = 0 /rmbr ∨ n.a.tb + n.b.tb ≠ n.toseq.tb then toseq.pseq(totallength, a, b, 0)/rmbr else cat3(totallength, a, a.tb, b.tb) else if n.a.ta + n.b.ta ≠ n.toseq.ta then toseq.pseq(totallength, a, b, 0)/rmbr else cat3(totallength, a.ta, b.ta, b)

Function subseq(s:seq.T, start:int, finish:int) seq.T /rmbr if start > finish then empty:seq.T /rmbr else if start < 1 then subseq(s, 1, finish) /rmbr else if finish > n.s then subseq(s, start, n.s) /rmbr else if start = 1 ∧ n.s = finish then s /rmbr else if start = finish + 1 then [s sub start, s sub finish] /rmbr else if start + 1 ≥ finish then if start = finish then [s sub start] /rmbr else[s sub start, s sub finish] else let p = to:pseq.T(s), /rmbr if n.toseq.p = 0 then toseq.pseq(finish - start + 1, s, s, start - 1)/rmbr else let adjstart = start + start.p - n.a.p /rmbr let adjfinish = start.p + finish - n.a.p, /rmbr if adjstart > 0 then{ all in part b } subseq(b.p, adjstart, adjfinish)/rmbr else if adjfinish > 0 then subseq(a.p, start.p + start, n.a.p)/rmbr + subseq(b.p, 1, adjfinish) else{ all in part a } subseq(a.p, start.p + start, start.p + finish)

Function isempty(a:seq.T) boolean n.a = 0

Function <<(s:seq.T, i:int) seq.T /rmbr{ * removes i elements from beginning of s } /rmbr subseq(s, i + 1, n.s)

Function ∩(a:set.T, b:set.T) set.T set. intersect(toseq.a, toseq.b, 1, 1)

function intersect(a:seq.T, b:seq.T, i:int, j:int) seq.T /rmbr if i > n.a then empty:seq.T /rmbr else if j > n.b then empty:seq.T /rmbr else let c = a sub i >1 b sub j, /rmbr if c = EQ then[a sub i] + intersect(a, b, i + 1, j + 1)/rmbr else if c = GT then intersect(a, b, i, j + 1) /rmbr else intersect(a, b, i + 1, j)

function union(a:set.T, b:set.T) set.T /rmbr if n.b = 0 then a /rmbr else if n.b = 1 then a + b sub 1 /rmbr else set. union(toseq.a, toseq.b, 1, 1, empty:seq.T)

Function ∪(a:set.T, b:set.T) set.T /rmbr if n.b = 0 then a /rmbr else if n.b = 1 then a + b sub 1 /rmbr else set. union(toseq.a, toseq.b, 1, 1, empty:seq.T)

function union(a:seq.T, b:seq.T, i:int, j:int, result:seq.T) seq.T /rmbr if i > n.a then result + subseq(b, j, n.b) /rmbr else if j > n.b then result + subseq(a, i, n.a) /rmbr else if a sub i >1 b sub j = GT then union(a, b, i, j + 1, result + b sub j)/rmbr else if a sub i >1 b sub j = EQ then union(a, b, i + 1, j + 1, result + a sub i)/rmbr else let p = binarysearch(a, i + 1, n.a, b sub j), /rmbr if p > 0 then union(a, b, p + 1, j + 1, result + subseq(a, i, p)) /rmbr else union(a, b, -p, j + 1, result + subseq(a, i, -p - 1) + [b sub j])

Function \(a:set.T, b:set.T) set.T /rmbr{ elements in a but not in b } /rmbr set. diff(toseq.a, toseq.b, 1, 1)

Function-(a:set.T, b:T) set.T set. setdelete(toseq.a, b)

function diff(a:seq.T, b:seq.T, i:int, j:int) seq.T /rmbr if i > n.a then empty:seq.T /rmbr else if j > n.b then subseq(a, i, n.a) /rmbr else if a sub i >1 b sub j = EQ then diff(a, b, i + 1, j + 1)/rmbr else if a sub i >1 b sub j = LT then[a sub i] + diff(a, b, i + 1, j)/rmbr else diff(a, b, i, j + 1)

unbound >2(T, T) ordering

Function findelement2(a:set.T, n:T) set.T /rmbr let i = binarysearch2(toseq.a, 1, n.toseq.a, n), /rmbr asset( if i < 0 then empty:seq.T /rmbr else for acc = empty:seq.T /rmbr, @e ∈ subseq(toseq.a, expandrangedown(toseq.a, n, i), expandrangeup(toseq.a, n, i)) do acc + @e, /rmbr acc)

function expandrangedown(a:seq.T, n:T, l:int) int /rmbr if l > 1 then if a sub (l - 1) >2 n = EQ then expandrangedown(a, n, l - 1)/rmbr else l else l

function expandrangeup(a:seq.T, n:T, u:int) int /rmbr if u < n.a then if a sub (u + 1)/rmbr >2 n /rmbr = EQ then expandrangeup(a, n, u + 1)/rmbr else u else u

Module sparseseq.T

* lets a sequence have a default value even beyond the length of the seq.

use seq.T

use seq1.sparseele.T

use standard

type sparseele is start:int, edata:seq.T

type sparse is sequence, sdata:seq.sparseele.T, default:T

Function >1(a:sparseele.T, b:sparseele.T) ordering start.a >1 start.b

function sequenceIndex(s:sparse.T, i:int) T /rmbr let place = binarysearch(sdata.s, sparseele(i, empty:seq.T)), /rmbr if place = -1 then default.s /rmbr else let k = if place < 0 then -place - 1 else place /rmbr let before = (sdata.s) sub k, /rmbr let beforeindex = i - start.before + 1, /rmbr if beforeindex > n.edata.before then default.s else(edata.before) sub beforeindex

Function sparseseq(a:T) seq.T toseq.sparse(1, empty:seq.sparseele.T, a)

Function replaceS(a:seq.T, i:int, b:seq.T) seq.T /rmbr let d = to:sparse.T(a), /rmbr if n.toseq.d = 0 then subseq(a, 1, i - 1)/rmbr + b /rmbr + subseq(a, i + n.b, n.a) else let ele = sparseele(i, b)/rmbr let place = binarysearch(sdata.d, ele)/rmbr let t = if place > 0 then subseq(sdata.d, 1, place - 1) * ele /rmbr + removeoverlap( i + n.b - 1 /rmbr, subseq(sdata.d, place + 1, n.sdata.d)/rmbr, 1) else subseq(sdata.d, 1, -place - 1)/rmbr * ele /rmbr + removeoverlap( i + n.b - 1 /rmbr, subseq(sdata.d, -place, n.sdata.d)/rmbr, 1), let last = t sub n.t, /rmbr toseq.sparse(start.last + n.edata.last - 1, t, default.d)

function removeoverlap(finish:int, s:seq.sparseele.T, i:int) seq.sparseele.T /rmbr if i > n.s then empty:seq.sparseele.T /rmbr else if finish < start.s sub i then s << (i - 1) /rmbr else let this = s sub i /rmbr let thisfinish = start.this + n.edata.this - 1, /rmbr if finish ≥ thisfinish then removeoverlap(finish, s, i + 1) /rmbr else[sparseele(finish + 1, edata.this << (finish - start.this))]/rmbr + s << i

function *(a:seq.sparseele.T, e:sparseele.T) seq.sparseele.T /rmbr if isempty.a then [e] /rmbr else let last = a sub n.a /rmbr let lastend = start.last + n.edata.last - 1, /rmbr if lastend < start.e then a + e /rmbr else a /rmbr >> 1 /rmbr * sparseele( start.last /rmbr, subseq(edata.last, 1, start.e - start.last)/rmbr + edata.e)

Function randomseq(seed:int, length:int) seq.int /rmbr{ Xorshift* see Wikapedia entry on Xorshift } /rmbr for acc = empty:seq.int, state = bits.seed /rmbr while n.acc < length /rmbr do let x1 = state ⊻ state >> 12 /rmbr let x2 = x1 ⊻ x1 << 25, /rmbr let nextrandom = x2 ⊻ x2 >> 27, /rmbr next(acc + toint.state * toint.0x2545F4914F6CDD1D, nextrandom) { ???? omitting acc gives strange error message } /rmbr acc

Function hexOrDecimal?(w:word) word /rmbr{ checks to see if the first 2 chars indicate the word may be integer in hex or decimal format and returns hex, decimal, or other } /rmbr let chars = decodeword.w /rmbr let len = n.chars, /rmbr if len = 0 then " other " sub 1 /rmbr else let i = if len > 1 /rmbr ∧ chars sub 1 = char1. " - " then 2 /rmbr else 1 let firstchar = toint.chars sub i, /rmbr if not. between(firstchar, 48, 57) then if len > 1 /rmbr ∧ char1. " ' " = chars sub 1 then" word " sub 1 /rmbr else" other " sub 1 else if firstchar = 48 /rmbr ∧ len > 2 /rmbr ∧ chars sub 2 /rmbr ∈ decodeword. " xX " sub 1 then" hex " sub 1 /rmbr else" decimal " sub 1

Function toUTF8(n:int) UTF8 /rmbr for acc = empty:seq.byte, e ∈ tochars.n /rmbr do acc + tobyte.toint.e, /rmbr UTF8.acc

Function encodeUTF8(ch:char) UTF8 /rmbr{ convert to UTF8 byte encoding of unicode character } /rmbr let i = toint.ch, /rmbr UTF8( if i < 128 then [ tobyte.i] /rmbr else for acc = [ tobyte(128 + i mod 64)]/rmbr, t = 32 /rmbr, c = i / 64 while c ≥ t /rmbr do next( [ tobyte(128 + c mod 64)]/rmbr + acc /rmbr, t / 2 /rmbr, c / 64),[ tobyte(256 - 2 * t + c)]/rmbr + acc)

Function decodeUTF8(b:UTF8) seq.char /rmbr{ converts UTF-8 encoded sequence into a sequence of chars } /rmbr for state = 0, val = 0, result = empty:seq.int, x0 ∈ toseqbyte.b /rmbr do let x = toint.x0, /rmbr if state = 0 then if x < 128 then next(0, 0, result + x) /rmbr else if x < 224 then next(1, (x - 192) * 64, result) /rmbr else if x < 240 then next(2, (x - 224) * 64, result) /rmbr else if x < 248 then next(3, (x - 240) * 64, result) /rmbr else if x < 252 then next(4, (x - 248) * 64, result) /rmbr else next(5, (x - 252) * 64, result) else if state = 1 then next(0, 0, result + (x + val - 128)) /rmbr else next( state - 1 /rmbr, (val + (x - 128)) * 64 /rmbr, result), tocharseq.result

Function toint(w:word) int /rmbr{ Convert an integer represented as a word to an int } /rmbr cvttoint. decodeword.w

Function cvttoint(s:seq.char) int /rmbr{ Hex values starting with 0x or 0X are allowed. } /rmbr if n.s > 2 /rmbr ∧ s sub 2 /rmbr ∈ decodeword. " Xx " sub 1 then for b = 0x0, c ∈ s /rmbr do let i = toint.c - toint. char1. " 0 " , /rmbr if between(i, 0, 9) then b << 4 ∨ bits.i /rmbr else let i2 = toint.c - toint. char1. " a " , /rmbr if between(i2, 0, 5) then b << 4 ∨ bits(i2 + 10) /rmbr else let i3 = toint.c - toint. char1. " A " , /rmbr if between(i3, 0, 5) then b << 4 ∨ bits(i3 + 10) /rmbr else assert c /rmbr ∈ [ char1. " x " /rmbr, char1. " X " /rmbr, { no breack space } char.160] report" invalid hex digit " + encodeword.s, /rmbr b, toint.b else for val = 0, c ∈ s /rmbr do let i = toint.c - toint. char1. " 0 " , /rmbr if between(i, 0, 9) then val * 10 - i /rmbr else assert c ∈ [ char1. " - " , { no breack space } char.160] report" invalid digit " + encodeword.s + stacktrace, /rmbr val{ Since there are more negative numbers in twos-complement we calculate using negative values. } /rmbr if val = 0 /rmbr ∨ s sub 1 = char1. " - " then val /rmbr else-val

Module xxhash

use bits

use kernal

Function rotateleft(x:bits, n:int) bits /rmbr x << n ∨ x >> (64 - n)

Function hash(acc:bits, x:int) bits /rmbr{ after xxhash /br /rmbr example use to hash x and y finalmix(hash(hash(hashstart(seed), x), y))} /rmbr let PRIME1 = 11400714785074694791 /rmbr let PRIME2 = 14029467366897019727 /rmbr let PRIME4 = 9650029242287828579, /rmbr bits( toint. rotateleft( acc /rmbr ⊻ bits( toint. rotateleft(bits(toint.acc + x * PRIME2), 31)/rmbr * PRIME1)/rmbr, 27)/rmbr * PRIME1 /rmbr + PRIME4)

Function hash32(hash:bits, key:int) bits /rmbr rotl32( bits(toint.hash + toint(bits.2246822519 * key))/rmbr, 13)/rmbr * 2654435761

Function *(a:bits, b:int) bits /rmbr let m = toint(bits.b ∨ bits.0)/rmbr let nlo = toint(a ∧ 0xFFFF)/rmbr let nhi = toint(a ∧ 0xFFFF << 16), /rmbr bits( toint(bits(nhi * m) ∧ 0xFFFF FFFF)/rmbr + nlo * m)/rmbr ∧ 0xFFFF FFFF

Function finalmix32(hash:bits) int /rmbr let h32c = (hash ⊻ hash >> 15)/rmbr * 668265263 let h32d = (h32c ⊻ h32c >> 13)/rmbr * 374761393, abs.toint( (h32d ⊻ h32d >> 16)/rmbr ∧ 0xFFFF FFFF)

Function hash(i:int) int /rmbr finalmix. hash( hashstart, i)

" sub 1 /rmbr, w /rmbr, suffix) else if filename = nofile then next(acc, w, last, prefix, suffix) /rmbr else next( acc + fixfilename(prefix, filename, suffix)/rmbr, w /rmbr, last /rmbr, prefix /rmbr, suffix), acc

Module timestamp

use UTF8

use bits

use seq.byte

use kernal

use standard

Export type:timestamp { From kernal }

function subseq(a:UTF8, i:int, j:int) UTF8 UTF8. subseq(toseqbyte.a, i, j)

Function tojulian(year:int, month:int, day:int) int /rmbr let ayear = if month > 2 then year else year - 1 /rmbr let amonth = if month > 2 then month else month + 12, /rmbr(amonth + 1) * 306001 / 10000 /rmbr + day /rmbr + 1720994 /rmbr + 2 /rmbr - ayear / 100 /rmbr + ayear / 100 / 4 /rmbr + 1461 * ayear / 4

Function dayofyear(t:timestamp) int /rmbr seconds.t / (24 * 60 * 60)/rmbr - tojulian( fromJuliantointseq(seconds.t / (24 * 60 * 60))/rmbr sub 1 /rmbr, 1 /rmbr, 1)/rmbr + 1

Function fromJuliantointseq(dt:int) seq.int /rmbr let a = ((dt + 1) * 4 - 7468865)/rmbr / 146097 let b = dt + 1 + 1 + a - a / 4 + 1524 /rmbr let c = (b * 20 - 2442) / 7305 /rmbr let d = b - 1461 * c / 4 /rmbr let e = d * 10000 / 306001 /rmbr let m = e - ( if e > 13 then 13 else 1), /rmbr[ c - ( if m > 2 then 4716 else 4715)/rmbr, m /rmbr, d - e * 306001 / 10000]

Function timestamplit(t:UTF8) timestamp /rmbr{ assumes t is in format 2019-12-12T12:48:11 } /rmbr let year = intlit. subseq(t, 1, 4)/rmbr let month = intlit. subseq(t, 6, 7)/rmbr let day = intlit. subseq(t, 9, 10)/rmbr let hour = intlit. subseq(t, 12, 13)/rmbr let minutes = intlit. subseq(t, 15, 16)/rmbr let second = intlit. subseq(t, 18, 19)/rmbr let date = tojulian(year, month, day), /rmbr timestamp( ((date * 24 + hour) * 60 /rmbr + minutes)/rmbr * 60 /rmbr + second)

Function totimestamp(/rmbr year:int /rmbr, month:int /rmbr, day:int /rmbr, hour:int /rmbr, minute:int /rmbr, second:int /rmbr) timestamp /rmbr timestamp( (( tojulian(year, month, day) * 24 /rmbr + hour)/rmbr * 60 /rmbr + minute)/rmbr * 60 /rmbr + second)

Function decompose(ts:timestamp) seq.int /rmbr{ returns sequence of year, month, day, hour, minute, second } /rmbr let a = seconds.ts mod (24 * 60 * 60)/rmbr let seconds = a mod 60 /rmbr let minutes = a / 60 mod 60 /rmbr let hours = a / 3600, /rmbr fromJuliantointseq(seconds.ts / (24 * 60 * 60))/rmbr + [hours, minutes, seconds]

Function print(ts:timestamp) seq.word /rmbr let d = decompose.ts, /rmbr[ merge.[ toword.d sub 1 /rmbr, " - " sub 1 /rmbr, toword.d sub 2 /rmbr, " - " sub 1 /rmbr, toword.d sub 3 /rmbr, " . " sub 1 /rmbr, toword.d sub 4 /rmbr, " : " sub 1 /rmbr, toword.d sub 5 /rmbr, " : " sub 1 /rmbr, toword.d sub 6] ]

Export timestamp(int) timestamp { From kernal }

Module typedict

use mytype

Function emptytypedict typedict typedict. empty:set.typeentry

function >1(a:typeentry, b:typeentry) ordering /rmbr(totypeseq.a) sub 1 >1 (totypeseq.b) sub 1

function type(a:typeentry) mytype (totypeseq.a) sub 1

function flatflds(a:typeentry) seq.mytype totypeseq.a << 1

function typeentry(t:mytype, flat:seq.mytype) typeentry typeentry([t] + flat)

Function addtype(alltypes:typedict, type:mytype) typedict /rmbr if iscore4.type ∨ type = typeT then alltypes /rmbr else if isseq.type then addtype(alltypes, parameter.type)/rmbr else let t = lookup(totypedict.alltypes, typeentry(type, empty:seq.mytype)), /rmbr if not. isempty.t then alltypes /rmbr else let flatflds = expandflat(type, empty:seq.mytype, totypedict.alltypes)/rmbr let newtr = typeentry(type, flatflds), /rmbr if isflat.newtr then{ add to typedict and then check to make sure parameters are in typedict } /rmbr for acc = typedict(totypedict.alltypes + newtr)/rmbr, subfld ∈ flatflds do if isseq.subfld /rmbr ∨ isencoding.subfld then addtype(acc, subfld)/rmbr else acc, acc else{ add types not in typedict and try again } /rmbr for acc = alltypes, subfld ∈ flatflds /rmbr do if iscore4.subfld /rmbr ∨ subfld = typeT /rmbr ∨ isseq.subfld /rmbr ∨ isencoding.subfld then acc /rmbr else addtype(acc, subfld) assert n.totypedict.alltypes < n.totypedict.acc report" PROBLEM :(type) flat: :(/rmbr for txt = "" , g ∈ flatflds do txt + %.g, /rmbr txt + " /br " /rmbr):(acc)" , addtype(acc, type)

Function buildtypedict(syms:set.symbol, types:seq.seq.mytype) typedict /rmbr for typesused = empty:seq.mytype, sym ∈ toseq.syms /rmbr do typesused + typesused.sym /rmbr for typesyms = empty:set.typeentry, tp ∈ types /rmbr do typesyms + typeentry(tp sub 1, tp << 1)/rmbr for acc3 = toseq.typesyms, q ∈ toseq. asset.typesused /rmbr do let z = typeentry(q, empty:seq.mytype), /rmbr if z ∈ typesyms then acc3 else acc3 + z, resolvetypesize.acc3

function typesused(sym:symbol) seq.mytype /rmbr{ only includes parameter of seq and encoding and excludes types int, real, boolea, ptr, and T } /rmbr for acc = empty:seq.mytype, t ∈ types.sym /rmbr do let typ = if isseq.t /rmbr ∨ isencoding.t then parameter.t /rmbr else t, if iscore4.typ ∨ typ = typeT then acc /rmbr else acc + typ, acc

function resolvetypesize(prg1:seq.typeentry) typedict /rmbr let bx5 = checkflat( empty:set.typeentry, prg1)/rmbr assert isempty.unknown.bx5 report" recursive type problem:/br :(/rmbr for acc10 = "" , h ∈ unknown.bx5 /rmbr do acc10 /rmbr + " type :( type.h) is :( %( " , " , flatflds.h))" /rmbr >> 1 /rmbr + " /br " , acc10 /rmbr)" for acc = emptytypedict, d ∈ toseq.known.bx5 /rmbr do add(acc, type.d, flatflds.d), /rmbr acc

function checkflat(types:set.typeentry, unknown:seq.typeentry) checkflatresult2 /rmbr for known = types, notflat = empty:seq.typeentry, p ∈ unknown /rmbr do if isflat.p /rmbr ∨ type.p = type? then next(known + p, notflat)/rmbr else let new = expandflat(p, types), /rmbr if isflat.new then next(known + new, notflat)/rmbr else next(known, notflat + new), if isempty.notflat ∨ n.unknown = n.notflat then checkflatresult2(known, notflat)/rmbr else checkflat(known, notflat)

type checkflatresult2 is known:set.typeentry, unknown:seq.typeentry

Function adjustbr(parts:seq.seq.symbol, amount:int) seq.seq.symbol /rmbr{ adjust branches that jump after what has been processed in outer block } /rmbr for tmp = parts, place = 1, e ∈ parts /rmbr do let x = e sub n.e /rmbr let kind = kind.x, /rmbr if kind = kbr then let adjustt = if brt.x + place > n.tmp + 1 then amount - 1 /rmbr else 0 let adjustf = if brf.x + place > n.tmp + 1 then amount - 1 /rmbr else 0, if adjustt + adjustf ≠ 0 then next( replace( tmp /rmbr, place /rmbr, e >> 1 /rmbr + Br2( brt.x + adjustt /rmbr, brf.x + adjustf) )/rmbr, place + 1) else next(tmp, place + 1) else if kind = kjmp then for acc = e >> ( value.x - 2)/rmbr, e2 ∈ subseq(e, n.e - value.x + 3, n.e - 1) do acc /rmbr + ( if kind.e2 = klabel then if value.e2 + place > n.tmp + 1 then Label( value.e2 + amount - 1)/rmbr else e2 else e2), next( replace(tmp, place, acc + e sub n.e)/rmbr, place + 1) else next(tmp, place + 1), tmp

function findsubexp(part:seq.symbol, subexp:seq.symbol) int /rmbr let last = subexp sub n.subexp /rmbr for idx = 1, nest = 0, e ∈ part /rmbr while idx > 0 /rmbr do if nest = 0 /rmbr ∧ not. isspecial. kind.e /rmbr ∧ e = last /rmbr ∧ subseq(part, idx - n.subexp + 1, idx)/rmbr = subexp then next(-idx, nest)/rmbr else let kind = kind.e, /rmbr next( idx + 1 /rmbr, if kind ∈ [ kstart, kloop] then nest + 1 /rmbr else if kind = kendblock then nest - 1 /rmbr else nest), abs.idx

function findCandidate(part:seq.symbol) int /rmbr for idx = 1, count = 0, nest = 0, e ∈ part /rmbr while idx > 0 /rmbr do let kind = kind.e, /rmbr if nest = 0 /rmbr ∧ ( isconst.kind /rmbr ∨ kind = klocal) then next(idx + 1, count + 1, nest)/rmbr else if kind ∈ [ kstart, kloop] then next(idx + 1, 0, nest + 1)/rmbr else if kind = kendblock then next(idx + 1, 0, nest - 1)/rmbr else if nest = 0 /rmbr ∧ count ≥ 2 /rmbr ∧ name.module.e ∈ " seq " /rmbr ∧ name.e ∈ " sub " then next(-idx, 0, nest)/rmbr else next(idx + 1, 0, nest), abs.idx

function tofromEnd(fromEnd:int, code:seq.symbol) fromEnd /rmbr fromEnd(fromEnd, flop(fromEnd, code))

function flop(fromEnd:int, code:seq.symbol) seq.symbol /rmbr{ flop Br offset from start and beginning of block to starting at end } /rmbr let last = code sub n.code /rmbr let kind = kind.last, /rmbr if kind = kbr then code >> 1 /rmbr + Br2( fromEnd - brt.last /rmbr, fromEnd - brf.last) else if kind = kjmp then for acc = empty:seq.symbol /rmbr, e ∈ subseq(code, n.code - value.last + 2, n.code - 1) do acc /rmbr + ( if kind.e = klabel then Label(fromEnd - value.e)/rmbr else e) let newEnd = acc + last, /rmbr code >> n.newEnd + newEnd else code

function check5(map:seq.int, e0:int, parts:seq.seq.symbol) seq.int /rmbr for acc = empty:seq.int, toprocess = [e0]/rmbr while not. isempty.toprocess /rmbr do let e1 = toprocess sub 1, /rmbr if map sub e1 ≠ 0 then next(acc, toprocess << 1) /rmbr else let last = last.parts sub e1 /rmbr let kind = kind.last, /rmbr if kind = kbr then next( [e1] + acc /rmbr, toprocess << 1 /rmbr + [ e1 + brt.last /rmbr, e1 + brf.last] ) else if kind = kjmp then next( [e1] + acc /rmbr, toprocess << 1 + jmplabels(e1, parts sub e1) ) else next([e1] + acc, toprocess << 1), acc

Function formatTypeDef(defs0:seq.seq.mytype) seq.seq.int /rmbr let defs = fix5.defs0 /rmbr for acc = empty:seq.seq.int, def ∈ defs /rmbr do if isseq.def sub 1 then let idx = for idx = 1, d ∈ defs /rmbr while d sub 1 /rmbr ≠ parameter.def sub 1 /rmbr do idx + 1, /rmbr idx, acc + [-idx] else for coded = empty:seq.int, t0 ∈ def << 1 /rmbr do let t = if isseq.t0 then parameter.t0 /rmbr else t0 for idx = 1, d ∈ defs /rmbr while d sub 1 ≠ t /rmbr do idx + 1, /rmbr coded + ( if isseq.t0 then -idx else idx), acc /rmbr + ( if isempty.coded then [n.acc + 1] else coded), acc

function real0 int 4

function buildword int /rmbr{ 1 <chars of word> } /rmbr 1

function buildrecord int /rmbr{ 2 rectyp <elements of record> } /rmbr 2

function buildseq int /rmbr{ 3 elementtyp <length of seq> <elements of seq> } /rmbr 3

function buildtblseq int /rmbr{ 5 rectyp <length of seq> elements of seq } /rmbr 5

function buildblock int /rmbr{ 6 elementyp <no of blocks> <length of seq> <elements of block seq> } /rmbr 6

{The format is a group of records that descibe types followed by[-1]followed by build records.

The first record is the root time. The next records with be[2],[3],[4]which represents the types, word, and real. A type with fields of type int, seq.word, and real would be represented by[2,-3, 4]. The absolute value of the elements is a pointer into records.Negative values represent a seq type.

When reconstructing objects, an object is built from each record. If the records is a buildword, buildtblrecord or a buldtblseq then the result object is added as the last element in the table otherwise the result object is placed on the stack. Elements of the record that are positive refer to and object in the table and negative elements refer to objects on the stack. After the object is built, the element references are pop from the stack. }

"" )/rmbr else if kind = kbr then reduce(stk, change) /rmbr else if kind = kexit then let stk1 = reduce(stk, change)/rmbr let thenpart = top.stk1 /rmbr let ifpart = undertop(stk1, 1)/rmbr let overallwidth = width.ifpart + width.thenpart + 5 /rmbr let fullifthen = " // :(text.ifpart) /spc // then /keyword " , /rmbr let tmp = if overallwidth > maxwidth then prettyR( 0 /rmbr, 10000 /rmbr, fullifthen /rmbr + removeclose. addblock.thenpart) else prettyR( 0 /rmbr, overallwidth /rmbr, fullifthen + " // " + removeclose.text.thenpart + " /spc " ), push( push( pop(stk1, 2), tmp)/rmbr, prettyR( { prec } 10 /rmbr, 7 /rmbr, if isempty.text. undertop(stk1, 2) then " // if /keyword " /rmbr else" // else if /keyword " ) ) else if kind = kendblock /rmbr ∧ n.toseq.stk ≥ 2 then let stk1 = reduce(stk, change)/rmbr let noblock = width. top.stk1 < 10000, /rmbr push( if noblock then stk1 /rmbr else push( pop.stk1 /rmbr, prettyR. addblock. top.stk1) , prettyR( { prec } 10, 7, " // else /keyword " ) ) else if kind = kint then push(stk, prettyR.[ name.sym])/rmbr else if kind = kwords then push( stk /rmbr, prettyR. failresult.top) else if actionState = !Fail then let top = top.stk /rmbr let ini = idxNB(myinput, i.top), /rmbr next(rinfo, pop.stk, Sstate.top, i.top, ini, result.top, faili.top, failresult.top) else if actionState = T then let te = idxNB(packedTable, index.state), /rmbr if inputi ≠ match.te then{ fail } /rmbr next(rinfo, stk, Fstate.te, faili, idxNB(myinput, faili), failresult, faili, failresult) else next(rinfo, stk, Sstate.te, i + 1, idxNB(myinput, i + 1), result, faili, failresult) else if actionState = !T then let te = idxNB(packedTable, index.state), /rmbr if inputi = match.te then{ fail } /rmbr next(rinfo, stk, Sstate.te, faili, idxNB(myinput, faili), failresult, faili, failresult) else next(rinfo, stk, Fstate.te, i, inputi, result, faili, failresult) else if actionState = MatchAny then let te = idxNB(packedTable, index.state), /rmbr if inputi = endMark then{ fail } next(rinfo, stk, Fstate.te, i, inputi, result, faili, failresult)/rmbr else let reslt = result + toAttribute(result sub n.result, [inputi]) let ini = idxNB(myinput, i + 1), /rmbr next(rinfo, stk, Sstate.te, i + 1, ini, reslt, faili, failresult) else if actionState = T' then let te = idxNB(packedTable, index.state), /rmbr if inputi = match.te then next(rinfo, stk, Sstate.te, i + 1, idxNB(myinput, i + 1), result, faili, failresult)/rmbr else next(rinfo, stk, Fstate.te, i, inputi, result, faili, failresult) else{ match non Terminal } /rmbr let te = idxNB(packedTable, index.state)/rmbr assert action.action.te ∈ [ NT, NT*] report" PROBLEM PEG :(state)" /rmbr let newstk = push(stk, frame(Sstate.te, Fstate.te, i, result, faili, failresult)), /rmbr let tmp = [ toAttribute(result sub n.result, empty:seq.word)], next( rinfo /rmbr, newstk /rmbr, nextState.action.te /rmbr, i /rmbr, inputi /rmbr, tmp /rmbr, i /rmbr, tmp), recoverInfo( push(stk.rinfo, frame(state, state, place.rinfo, result, n.myinput, result))/rmbr, input.rinfo /rmbr, place.rinfo /rmbr, faili.rinfo)

Module parser

use PEGrules

use UTF8

use seq.bindinfo

use seq.char

use mytype

use seq.mytype

type commonType is types:set.mytype, outText:boolean, input:seq.word

type bindinfo is dict:symboldict, code:seq.symbol, types:seq.mytype, text:seq.word

Function parser(/rmbr input:seq.word /rmbr, dict:symboldict /rmbr, types:set.mytype /rmbr, outText:boolean /rmbr) seq.symbol /rmbr{ OPTION XPROFILE } /rmbr let b = bindinfo(dict, empty:seq.symbol, empty:seq.mytype, "" )/rmbr let tokens = totokens.input /rmbr let r = parse(packed.tokens, b, commonType(types, outText, input))/rmbr assert status.r ∈ " Match " report errormessage( " syntax error " , recoverInfo( pop.stk.r, tokens, i. top.stk.r, 1)), /rmbr code. result.r

function toAttribute(b:bindinfo, w:seq.word) bindinfo /rmbr bindinfo(dict.b, empty:seq.symbol, empty:seq.mytype, w)

function toAttribute(b:bindinfo, t:seq.token) bindinfo /rmbr for w = "" , e ∈ t do w + toword.e, /rmbr bindinfo(dict.b, empty:seq.symbol, empty:seq.mytype, w)

function errormessage(message:seq.word, rinfo:recoverInfo) seq.word /rmbr let input = input.rinfo /rmbr let place = place.rinfo /rmbr let ending = recoveryEnding.rinfo /rmbr let pp = prettyNoChange( towords. subseq(input, 1, place - 1)/rmbr + ending) for idx = n.pp /rmbr, remove = ending /rmbr, addback = "" /rmbr, go = not. isempty.ending /rmbr, e ∈ reverse.pp while go /rmbr do if e = last.remove then next(idx - 1, remove >> 1, addback, n.remove > 1)/rmbr else assert true report" ERR DEBUG :( showZ.remove) /p :( showZ.pp)" , /rmbr if e ∈ " /literal :( escapeformat)" then next(idx - 1, remove, [e] + addback, go)/rmbr else if e ∈ " /keyword /br, " then next(idx - 1, remove, addback, go) /rmbr else next(idx - 1, remove, addback, false) let t = ":( red.message) /br :( subseq(pp, 1, idx))" for unprocessed = "" /rmbr, e ∈ subseq(input, place, min(place + 10, n.input - 1)) do unprocessed + toword.e, /rmbr( if not. isempty.t /rmbr ∧ last.t ∈ " /keyword " then t >> 1 + addback /rmbr else t + addback)/rmbr + " /br :( red.message) /br " /rmbr + ( if isempty.unprocessed then " at end but expecting: :(ending)" /rmbr else" Replaced :(/rmbr dq( if place + 11 < n.input then unprocessed + " … " /rmbr else unprocessed)/rmbr) with :(ending) to parse. " )

Function binary(R0:bindinfo, firsttoken:token, R1:bindinfo) bindinfo /rmbr let op = toword.firsttoken, /rmbr bindinfo( dict.R0 /rmbr, code.R0 + code.R1 /rmbr, types.R0 + types.R1 /rmbr, text.R0 + text.R1 + op + %.n.code.R1)

Function binaryops(/rmbr static:commonType /rmbr, R0:bindinfo /rmbr, R1:bindinfo /rmbr, rinfo:recoverInfo /rmbr) bindinfo /rmbr let input = input.rinfo /rmbr let place = place.rinfo /rmbr let parsestk = stk.rinfo, /rmbr if isempty.text.R1 then R0 /rmbr else let dict = dict.R0 /rmbr for arg1code = code.R0, arg1type = types.R0, start = 1, ops = text.R1, arg2type ∈ types.R1 /rmbr do let types = arg1type + arg2type /rmbr let op = [ops sub 1]/rmbr let len = toint.ops sub 2, /rmbr let arg2code = subseq(code.R1, start, start + len - 1), /rmbr if op sub 1 ∈ " ∧ ∨ " /rmbr ∧ types /rmbr = [ typeboolean, typeboolean]/rmbr ∧ not.outText.static then let code = if op = " ∧ " then ifthenelse( arg1code /rmbr, arg2code /rmbr, [ Litfalse]/rmbr, typeboolean) else ifthenelse( arg1code /rmbr, [ Littrue]/rmbr, arg2code /rmbr, typeboolean), next(code, [ typeboolean], start + len, ops << 2) else let idx = findindex( " ≠ ≥ ≤ ∉ " , op sub 1)/rmbr let f = if idx > 4 then [ lookupbysig(static, dict, [op sub 1], types, rinfo)] /rmbr else let f1 = lookupbysig(static, dict, [ " = < > ∈ " sub idx], types, rinfo), /rmbr if outText.static then[ symbol( module.f1 /rmbr, op /rmbr, paratypes.f1 /rmbr, resulttype.f1) ] else[f1, NotOp], next( arg1code + arg2code + f /rmbr, [ resulttype.f sub 1]/rmbr, start + len /rmbr, ops << 2), bindinfo(dict, arg1code, arg1type, "" )

function strExp(/rmbr static:commonType /rmbr, R0:bindinfo /rmbr, str:seq.word /rmbr, forcecode:boolean /rmbr, expcode:seq.symbol /rmbr, exptype:mytype /rmbr, rinfo:recoverInfo /rmbr) bindinfo /rmbr let t = seqof. typeword, /rmbr if isempty.expcode then if isempty.code.R0 then if forcecode then bindinfo(dict.R0, [ Words(text.R0 + str)], [t], "" ) /rmbr else bindinfo(dict.R0, code.R0, types.R0, text.R0 + str) else if isempty.str then R0 /rmbr else let f = lookupbysig(static, dict.R0, " + " , [t, t], rinfo), /rmbr bindinfo(dict.R0, code.R0 + Words.str + f, [t], "" ) else let f = lookupbysig(static, dict.R0, " + " , [t, t], rinfo)/rmbr let codeexp = if exptype = t then expcode /rmbr else let cvt = lookupbysig(static, dict.R0, " % " , [exptype], rinfo)/rmbr assert resulttype.cvt /rmbr = seqof. typeword report errormessage( " Expected function :(cvt) to have return type of seq.word " , rinfo), /rmbr expcode + cvt, if isempty.code.R0 /rmbr ∧ isempty.text.R0 /rmbr ∧ not.outText.static then bindinfo(dict.R0, codeexp, [t], "" )/rmbr else let code1 = if isempty.code.R0 then[ Words.text.R0]/rmbr else code.R0, bindinfo(dict.R0, code1 + codeexp + f, [t], "" )

Function ifExp(/rmbr static:commonType /rmbr, R0:bindinfo /rmbr, cond:bindinfo /rmbr, thenpart:bindinfo /rmbr, rinfo:recoverInfo /rmbr) bindinfo /rmbr assert (types.cond) sub 1 /rmbr = typeboolean report errormessage( " cond of if must be boolean but is :((types.cond) sub 1)" /rmbr, rinfo) assert isempty.types.R0 ∨ types.R0 = types.thenpart report errormessage( " then and else types are different " , rinfo), /rmbr bindinfo( dict.R0 /rmbr, code.R0 + code.cond + Br2(1, 2) + code.thenpart + Exit /rmbr, types.thenpart /rmbr, "" )

function ifExp(/rmbr static:commonType /rmbr, cond:bindinfo /rmbr, thenpart:bindinfo /rmbr, elseifpart:bindinfo /rmbr, elsepart:bindinfo /rmbr, rinfo:recoverInfo /rmbr) bindinfo /rmbr let t = ifExp(static, toAttribute(cond, "" ), cond, thenpart, rinfo)/rmbr assert types.thenpart = types.elsepart /rmbr ∧ ( isempty.types.elseifpart /rmbr ∨ types.elseifpart = types.thenpart) report errormessage( " then and else types are different " , rinfo), /rmbr bindinfo( dict.cond /rmbr, [ Start.(types.thenpart) sub 1]/rmbr + code.t /rmbr + code.elseifpart /rmbr + ( if outText.static then code.elsepart + EndBlock /rmbr else code.elsepart + Exit + EndBlock)/rmbr, types.elsepart /rmbr, "" )

function declarePara(d:symboldict, names:seq.word, types:seq.mytype) bindinfo /rmbr for dict = d, no = 1, t ∈ types /rmbr do next( dict + Local(names sub no, t, no)/rmbr, no + 1), bindinfo(dict, empty:seq.symbol, empty:seq.mytype, "" )

function lookupbysig(/rmbr static:commonType /rmbr, dict:symboldict /rmbr, name:seq.word /rmbr, paratypes:seq.mytype /rmbr, rinfo:recoverInfo /rmbr) symbol /rmbr let sym3 = if n.name = 1 then symbol( internalmod /rmbr, name /rmbr, paratypes /rmbr, typeint) else symbol4( internalmod /rmbr, name sub 1 /rmbr, resolvetype(static, name << 1, rinfo)/rmbr, paratypes /rmbr, typeint) let f0 = lookupbysig(dict, sym3)/rmbr let f = if n.f0 < 2 then f0 /rmbr else for bound = empty:set.symbol /rmbr, unbound = empty:set.symbol /rmbr, sy ∈ toseq.f0 do if isunbound.sy then next(bound, unbound + sy) /rmbr else next(bound + sy, unbound), if isempty.bound /rmbr ∧ not. isempty.unbound then{ Allow multiple unbound with same signature } subseq(unbound, 1, 1)/rmbr else bound assert not. isempty.f report if n.name = 1 /rmbr ∧ name sub 1 ∈ " if else then for " then errormessage( " Syntax error " , rinfo)/rmbr else errormessage( " cannot find 1 :(/rmbr( if n.name = 1 then name /rmbr else[name sub 1, " : " sub 1]/rmbr + name << 1)/rmbr) ( :(/rmbr for acc = "" , @e ∈ paratypes /rmbr do acc + %.@e + " , " , /rmbr acc >> 1 /rmbr) ) " /rmbr, rinfo) assert n.f = 1 report errormessage( " found more than one :(/rmbr for acc = "" , @e ∈ toseq.f /rmbr do acc + library.module.@e + " . " + %.@e, /rmbr acc /rmbr)" /rmbr, rinfo) let discard = for acc = 0 /rmbr, sym2 ∈ requires(dict, f sub 1) do let xxx = lookupbysig(dict, sym2)/rmbr assert not. isempty.xxx /rmbr ∨ isAbstract.module.f sub 1 report errormessage( " using symbol :(f sub 1) requires unbound :(sym2)" , rinfo), /rmbr 0, 0, f sub 1

Function addpara(/rmbr static:commonType /rmbr, name:seq.word /rmbr, ptype:bindinfo /rmbr, rinfo:recoverInfo /rmbr) bindinfo /rmbr let b = ptype /rmbr let paratype = resolvetype(static, text.ptype, rinfo)/rmbr assert isempty. lookupbysig(dict.b, name)/rmbr ∨ name = " : " report errormessage( " duplciate symbol: :(name)" , rinfo), /rmbr bindinfo(dict.b, empty:seq.symbol, [paratype], name)

Function addpara(/rmbr static:commonType /rmbr, b:bindinfo /rmbr, name:seq.word /rmbr, ptype:bindinfo /rmbr, rinfo:recoverInfo /rmbr) bindinfo /rmbr let paratype = resolvetype(static, text.ptype, rinfo)/rmbr assert isempty. lookupbysig(dict.b, name)/rmbr ∨ name = " : " report errormessage( " duplciate symbol: :(name)" , rinfo), /rmbr bindinfo( dict.b + Local(name sub 1, paratype, n.text.b + 1)/rmbr, empty:seq.symbol /rmbr, empty:seq.mytype /rmbr, text.b + name)

Function seqExp(static:commonType, R:bindinfo, rinfo:recoverInfo) bindinfo /rmbr let types = types.R /rmbr assert for acc = true, @e ∈ types /rmbr do acc ∧ types sub 1 = @e, /rmbr acc report errormessage( " types do not match in build " , rinfo), /rmbr bindinfo( dict.R /rmbr, code.R + Sequence(types sub 1, n.types)/rmbr, [ seqof.types sub 1]/rmbr, "" )

Function letExp(static:commonType, R:bindinfo, exp:bindinfo, rinfo:recoverInfo) bindinfo /rmbr let name = text.R /rmbr assert isempty. lookupbysig(dict.R, name) report errormessage( " duplicate symbol: :(name)" , rinfo)/rmbr let newdict = dict.R /rmbr + Local( name sub 1 /rmbr, (types.exp) sub 1 /rmbr, cardinality.dict.R), bindinfo( newdict /rmbr, code.R /rmbr + code.exp /rmbr + Define( name sub 1 /rmbr, cardinality.dict.R)/rmbr, types.exp /rmbr, name)

Function bindlit2(static:commonType, R:bindinfo, rinfo:recoverInfo) bindinfo /rmbr assert not. isempty.text.R report" bindlit2 " /rmbr let kind = hexOrDecimal?.(text.R) sub 1, /rmbr if kind ∈ " other " then let f = lookupbysig(static, dict.R, text.R, empty:seq.mytype, rinfo), /rmbr bindinfo(dict.R, [f], [ resulttype.f], "" ) else let rt = if kind ∈ " word " then typeword /rmbr else if kind ∈ " hex " then typebits /rmbr else typeint, bindinfo( dict.R /rmbr, [ if outText.static then symbol( internalmod, text.R, empty:seq.mytype, rt)/rmbr else let val = (text.R) sub 1, /rmbr if kind ∈ " word " then Word. encodeword( decodeword.val << 1) else Lit.val]/rmbr, [rt]/rmbr, "" )

Function unaryop(/rmbr static:commonType /rmbr, dict:symboldict /rmbr, rinfo:recoverInfo /rmbr, op:seq.word /rmbr, exp:bindinfo /rmbr) bindinfo /rmbr if op sub 1 = " process " sub 1 /rmbr ∧ n.types.exp = 1 then let rt = resolvetype(types.static, %.(types.exp) sub 1)/rmbr sub 1 let processtype = processof.rt /rmbr let dcws = deepcopyseqword, /rmbr let newcode = [ Fref. deepcopySym.rt /rmbr, Fref.dcws /rmbr, Fref. last.code.exp]/rmbr + subseq(code.exp, 1, n.code.exp - 1)/rmbr + [ Lit.0 /rmbr, Fref. last.code.exp]/rmbr + Record( [ typeint /rmbr, typeint /rmbr, typeint]/rmbr + paratypes. last.code.exp /rmbr + typeint /rmbr + typeint)/rmbr + symbol( builtinmod.rt /rmbr, " createthreadZ " /rmbr, [ typeptr]/rmbr, processtype), bindinfo( dict /rmbr, if outText.static then code.exp + symbol( internalmod, " process " , [rt], rt)/rmbr else newcode /rmbr, [processtype]/rmbr, "" ) else if hexOrDecimal?.op sub 1 /rmbr ∈ " hex decimal " /rmbr ∧ n.code.exp = 1 then let dec = if outText.static then name.(code.exp) sub 1 /rmbr else assert kind.(code.exp) sub 1 /rmbr = kint report errormessage( " illformed real literal " , rinfo), /rmbr name.(code.exp) sub 1 let makerealSymbol = symbol( moduleref. " * real " /rmbr, " makereal " /rmbr, [ seqof. typeword]/rmbr, typereal), bindinfo( dict /rmbr, [ Words(op + " . " + dec), makerealSymbol]/rmbr, [ typereal]/rmbr, "" ) else let f = lookupbysig(static, dict, op, types.exp, rinfo), /rmbr bindinfo(dict, code.exp + f, [ resulttype.f], "" )

function resolvetype(static:commonType, text:seq.word, rinfo:recoverInfo) mytype /rmbr let a = resolvetype(types.static, text)/rmbr assert not. isempty.a report errormessage( " cannot resolve type :(text)" , rinfo), /rmbr a sub 1

Function checktype(/rmbr static:commonType /rmbr, functype:bindinfo /rmbr, Declare:bindinfo /rmbr, exp:bindinfo /rmbr, rinfo:recoverInfo /rmbr) bindinfo /rmbr let returntype = resolvetype(static, text.functype, rinfo)/rmbr assert returntype = (types.exp) sub 1 report errormessage( " function type of :(returntype) does not match expression type :((types.exp) sub 1)" /rmbr, rinfo), bindinfo(dict.exp, mergeText(static, code.Declare, code.exp), empty:seq.mytype, "" )

Function forSeqExp(/rmbr static:commonType /rmbr, accum0:bindinfo /rmbr, elename:seq.word /rmbr, theseq:bindinfo /rmbr, rinfo:recoverInfo /rmbr) bindinfo /rmbr let noseq = elename = " . " /rmbr let oldnesting = lookupbysig(dict.accum0, " for " )/rmbr let basetype = typebase. cardinality.dict.accum0{ we declare accumulators after all initial values are calculated since initial values may change size of symboldict. } /rmbr for accdict = dict.accum0, i = 1, name ∈ text.accum0 /rmbr do assert isempty. lookupbysig(dict.accum0, [name]) report errormessage( " duplicate symbol: :(name)" , rinfo)/rmbr let z = Local(name, (types.accum0) sub i, cardinality.accdict), next(accdict + z, i + 1) let seqtype = if noseq then seqof. typeint /rmbr else let seqtype0 = (types.theseq) sub 1 /rmbr assert isempty. lookupbysig(accdict, elename) report errormessage( " duplicate symbol: :(elename)" , rinfo), /rmbr assert isseq.seqtype0 report errormessage( " final expression in for list must be a sequence but it is of type: :(seqtype0)" , rinfo), /rmbr seqtype0{ keep track so right next is used in nested fors } /rmbr let lastaccum = cardinality.accdict - 1 /rmbr let elementSym = Local( elename sub 1 /rmbr, parameter.seqtype /rmbr, lastaccum + 2) let dict2 = accdict /rmbr + Local( toword(lastaccum + 1)/rmbr, seqtype /rmbr, lastaccum + 1)/rmbr + elementSym /rmbr + Local( toword(lastaccum + 3)/rmbr, typeint /rmbr, lastaccum + 3)/rmbr + Local( toword(lastaccum + 4)/rmbr, typeint /rmbr, lastaccum + 4)/rmbr + Local( toword(lastaccum + 2)/rmbr, typeint /rmbr, lastaccum + 5) let nextSym = symbol( moduleref( " internallib $for " , basetype)/rmbr, " next " /rmbr, types.accum0 /rmbr, basetype) { assert not.noseq report %(types.accum0+parameter.seqtype)+"KLJ:"+text.accum0+elename } /rmbr bindinfo( addAccum(dict2, nextSym, basetype, oldnesting, elementSym)/rmbr, if noseq then code.accum0 else code.accum0 + code.theseq /rmbr, types.accum0 + parameter.seqtype /rmbr, text.accum0 + elename)

Function assertExp(/rmbr static:commonType /rmbr, cond:bindinfo /rmbr, exp:bindinfo /rmbr, rinfo:recoverInfo /rmbr) bindinfo /rmbr assert (types.cond) sub 1 /rmbr = typeboolean report errormessage( " condition in assert must be boolean in: " , rinfo)/rmbr assert (types.exp) sub 1 /rmbr = seqof. typeword report errormessage( " report in assert must be seq of word in: " , rinfo), /rmbr if outText.static then bindinfo( dict.cond /rmbr, code.cond /rmbr + code.exp /rmbr + symbol( internalmod /rmbr, " $assert " /rmbr, [ typeboolean /rmbr, seqof. typeword]/rmbr, typeint)/rmbr, [ typeint]/rmbr, "" ) else let assertsym = symbol( internalmod /rmbr, " assert " /rmbr, [ seqof. typeword]/rmbr, typeint), bindinfo( dict.cond /rmbr, [ Start. typeint]/rmbr + code.cond /rmbr + Br2(1, 2)/rmbr + Lit.0 /rmbr + Exit /rmbr + code.exp /rmbr + assertsym /rmbr + Exit /rmbr + EndBlock /rmbr + Define( " assert " sub 1 /rmbr, cardinality.dict.cond)/rmbr, empty:seq.mytype /rmbr, "" )

Function forbody(/rmbr static:commonType /rmbr, vars:bindinfo /rmbr, exitexp:bindinfo /rmbr, forbodyin:bindinfo /rmbr, rinfo:recoverInfo /rmbr) bindinfo /rmbr let textvars = text.vars /rmbr let codevars = code.vars /rmbr let typesvars = types.vars /rmbr let accumTypes = typesvars >> 1 /rmbr let theseqtype = last.types.vars /rmbr let nowhile = code.exitexp = [ Littrue]/rmbr let noseq = last.text.vars ∈ " . " /rmbr let forbodytype = resulttype. lookupbysig(dict.vars, " for " )/rmbr sub 1 let forbody = if n.accumTypes = 1 ∧ forbodytype = (types.forbodyin) sub 1 then{ handle next with single accumulator } /rmbr bindinfo(dict.forbodyin, code.forbodyin >> 1, [accumTypes sub 1], text.forbodyin) else forbodyin let actualbodytype = (types.forbody) sub 1 /rmbr let checktypes = if (types.exitexp) sub 1 /rmbr = typeboolean then{ while type is OK. now check body type } /rmbr if n.accumTypes > 1 then if forbodytype = actualbodytype then "" else" incorrect body type: :(actualbodytype)" /rmbr else if accumTypes sub 1 = actualbodytype then{ body type is OK, now check to see if while clause is required } /rmbr if noseq ∧ code.exitexp = [ Littrue] then" While clause must be present and not equal to true when no sequence is specified. " /rmbr else"" else" Type of body expression :(actualbodytype) must match accumulator type :(accumTypes sub 1)" else" while expresssion type must be boolean " assert isempty.checktypes report /rmbr, accumTypes /rmbr + ( if noseq then empty:seq.mytype else[theseqtype])/rmbr + typeboolean /rmbr + (types.forbody) sub 1 /rmbr + seqof. typeword /rmbr, typeint) else let firstvar = toint.( %. parameter.forbodytype)/rmbr sub 1 let lastidx = Local(firstvar + n.accumTypes)/rmbr let theseq = Local( value.lastidx + 2), /rmbr let totallength = Local( value.lastidx + 3), /rmbr if noseq then codevars /rmbr + Loopblock(accumTypes, firstvar, typeint)/rmbr + code.exitexp /rmbr + Br2(2, 1)/rmbr + Lit.0 /rmbr + Exit /rmbr + code.forbody /rmbr + ( if n.accumTypes = 1 then [ continue.1] /rmbr else[ Exit])/rmbr + EndBlock /rmbr + Define. value.totallength else let masterindex = Local( value.lastidx + 4)/rmbr let reverse = name.module. last.codevars ∈ " seq1 " /rmbr ∧ name. last.codevars ∈ " reverse " let continue = if n.accumTypes = 1 then [masterindex, continue.2] /rmbr else[ Exit] let setElement = [ lastidx /rmbr, if reverse then Lit.-1 /rmbr else Lit.1 /rmbr, PlusOp /rmbr, Define. value.masterindex /rmbr, theseq /rmbr, masterindex /rmbr, symIdxNB.theseqtype /rmbr, Define( value.lastidx + 1) ], let part1 = if reverse then codevars >> 1 /rmbr + Define. value.theseq /rmbr + theseq /rmbr + GetSeqLength /rmbr + Define. value.totallength /rmbr + totallength /rmbr + Lit.1 /rmbr + PlusOp /rmbr + Loopblock( accumTypes + typeint /rmbr, firstvar /rmbr, typeint)/rmbr + [lastidx, Lit.1, EqOp] else codevars /rmbr + Define. value.theseq /rmbr + theseq /rmbr + GetSeqLength /rmbr + Define. value.totallength /rmbr + Lit.0 /rmbr + Loopblock( accumTypes + typeint /rmbr, firstvar /rmbr, typeint)/rmbr + [lastidx, totallength, EqOp], part1 /rmbr + ( if nowhile then let seq? = last.code.forbody, /rmbr[ Br2(1, 2)]/rmbr + Lit.0 /rmbr + Exit /rmbr + setElement /rmbr + code.forbody /rmbr + continue /rmbr + EndBlock /rmbr + Define. value.totallength else[ Br2(2, 1)]/rmbr + setElement /rmbr + code.exitexp /rmbr + Br2(2, 1)/rmbr + Lit.0 /rmbr + Exit /rmbr + code.forbody /rmbr + continue /rmbr + EndBlock /rmbr + Define. value.totallength), bindinfo( restorenext.dict.vars /rmbr, newcode /rmbr, [ typeint]/rmbr, "" )

function mergeText(static:commonType, a:seq.symbol, b:seq.symbol) seq.symbol /rmbr if outText.static /rmbr ∧ not. isempty.a /rmbr ∧ not. isempty.b then a /rmbr + b /rmbr + symbol( internalmod /rmbr, " $mergecode " /rmbr, [ typeint, typeint]/rmbr, typeint) else a + b

function endMark token /rmbr totoken. encodeword.[char.254]

function firsttoken(r:recoverInfo) token (input.r) sub faili.r

function colon seq.word " : "

use standard

type tblEle is action:state, match:token, Sstate:state, Fstate:state, recover:seq.word

function recoveryEnding(rinfo:recoverInfo) seq.word /rmbr for acc = "" , frame ∈ reverse.toseq.stk.rinfo /rmbr do if action.Sstate.frame /rmbr ∈ [ T, T', NT] then acc /rmbr + recover. mytable sub index.Sstate.frame else acc, acc

type frame is Sstate:state, Fstate:state, i:int, result:seq.bindinfo, faili:int, failresult:seq.bindinfo

type recoverInfo is stk:stack.frame, input:seq.token, place:int, faili:int

Function status(a:recoverInfo) word /rmbr if Sstate. top.stk.a ≠ Match then 'Failed /rmbr else if place.a = { length of input } faili. top.stk.a then 'Match /rmbr else 'MatchPrefix

Function result(a:recoverInfo) bindinfo /rmbr last.result. top.stk.a

function parse(myinput0:seq.token, initAttr:bindinfo, common:commonType) recoverInfo /rmbr let myinput = packed(myinput0 + endMark)/rmbr let packedTable = packed. mytable /rmbr for rinfo = recoverInfo( empty:stack.frame, myinput, 0, 1)/rmbr, stk = empty:stack.frame /rmbr, state = startstate /rmbr, i = 1 /rmbr, inputi = myinput sub 1 /rmbr, result = [initAttr]/rmbr, faili = 1 /rmbr, failresult = [initAttr] while toint.state > toint. /rmbr, pop.stk /rmbr, Fstate.top /rmbr, faili.top /rmbr, idxNB(myinput, faili.top)/rmbr, failresult.top /rmbr, faili.top /rmbr, failresult.top) else if actionState = Success* then{ goto /rmbr, nextState.state /rmbr, i /rmbr, inputi /rmbr, result.top /rmbr, i /rmbr, result.top) else if actionState = All then let top = top.stk /rmbr let att = [ toAttribute(result sub n.result,
