type lineinfo is output:seq.filename, input:seq.filename, line:seq.word, def:cmddef

function >1(a:lineinfo, b:lineinfo) ordering /rmbr(output.a) sub 1 >1 (output.b) sub 1

function %(a:lineinfo) seq.word /rmbr %.output.a /rmbr + %.input.a /rmbr + line.a

Function makeScript(/rmbr input:seq.file /rmbr, builddir:seq.word /rmbr, hashes:seq.file /rmbr, output:seq.word /rmbr) seq.byte /rmbr{ COMMAND makeScript /strong creates shell script for building code./br /rmbr The commands' primary is is in the shell script taubuild./br /rmbr input /strong build files /br /rmbr builddir /strong build directory, usually"+built"./br /rmbr hashes /strong two files with one containing lines from the unix command shasum. The two files are compared looking for identical lines which is used to determine which files have not be changed since the last build.} /rmbr let txtbytes = toseqbyte. textFormat. " if /sp[[/sp-n true /sp]]; then /br :( $$):( makeScriptCore(input, builddir, " script " sub 1, hashes)) /br else /br :( $$) shahash of source files /br " let databytes = if isempty.hashes then empty:seq.byte /rmbr else data.hashes sub 1, txtbytes /rmbr + tobyte.10 /rmbr + databytes /rmbr + toseqbyte. textFormat. " /br fi "

function tolineinfo(line0:seq.word, builddir:seq.word, cmddef:cmddef) lineinfo /rmbr let line = if subseq(line0, 3, 3) ∈ [ " : " , " : " ] then line0 /rmbr else %.line0 sub 1 /rmbr + " input: " /rmbr + line0 << 1 for outfn = empty:seq.filename /rmbr, infn = if cmdlib.cmddef ∉ " shell " then[ filename(builddir + ":( cmdlib.cmddef) .lib " )]/rmbr else empty:seq.filename /rmbr, acc = "" /rmbr, value = "" /rmbr, invalue = false /rmbr, last = line sub 1 /rmbr, w ∈ line + " .:x " do if w ∉ " :: " then if invalue then next(outfn, infn, acc, value + w, invalue, w) /rmbr else next(outfn, infn, acc + w, value, invalue, w) else let newstate = last ∈ ( infiles.cmddef + " output " ), /rmbr if not.invalue then next(outfn, infn, acc + w, value, newstate, w)/rmbr else let name = acc sub (n.acc - 1)/rmbr let filenames = if n.value < 2 then empty:seq.filename else tofilenames(builddir + value >> 1), let newacc = acc + fullnames.filenames + [last, w], if name ∈ " output " then next(filenames, infn, newacc, "" , newstate, w) /rmbr else next(outfn, infn + filenames, newacc, "" , newstate, w) assert not. isempty.outfn report" must specify /em output in:/sp :(line)" , /rmbr if ext.outfn sub 1 ∈ " lib " /rmbr ∧ (toseq.cmddef) sub 3 ∉ " shell " then for dependlibs = " /br dependlibs /nsp _ /nsp :(name.outfn sub 1) /nsp = :( dq)" /rmbr, fn ∈ infn do if ext.fn ∈ " libinfo " then dependlibs + " built /nsp / /nsp :(name.fn) .bc " else dependlibs, /rmbr lineinfo( outfn /rmbr, infn /rmbr, acc >> 3 /rmbr + dependlibs /rmbr + dq /rmbr + " /br linklibrary :(name.outfn sub 1)" /rmbr + " output: " /rmbr + fullnames.outfn /rmbr, cmddef) else lineinfo(outfn, infn, acc >> 3, cmddef)

function substitute(s:seq.word, b:seq.word, replacement:seq.word) seq.word /rmbr let i = findindex(s, b sub n.b), /rmbr if i > n.s then s /rmbr else if subseq(s, i - n.b + 1, i)/rmbr = b then subseq(s, 1, i - n.b)/rmbr + replacement /rmbr + substitute(s << i, b, replacement) else subseq(s, 1, i)/rmbr + substitute(s << i, b, replacement)

function unchanged(hashes:seq.file) seq.filename /rmbr if n.hashes < 2 then empty:seq.filename /rmbr else let lines = toseq( asset. breaklines. data.hashes sub 1 /rmbr ∩ asset. breaklines. data.hashes sub 2), if isempty.lines then empty:seq.filename /rmbr else let i = findindex( toseqbyte.lines sub 1 /rmbr, tobyte.toint.char.32) for unchanged = empty:seq.filename, line ∈ lines /rmbr do for j = n.toseqbyte.line, b ∈ reverse.toseqbyte.line /rmbr while b /rmbr ∉ [ tobyte.toint. char1. " / " /rmbr, tobyte.32] /rmbr do j - 1 /rmbr let t = towords.UTF8( subseq(toseqbyte.line, i + 1, j - 1)/rmbr + tobyte.32 /rmbr + subseq(toseqbyte.line, j + 1, n.toseqbyte.line) ), if n.t = 4 then unchanged + filename. " + :(t)" /rmbr else if n.t = 1 then unchanged + filename.t /rmbr else assert n.t = 3 ∧ t sub 2 ∈ " . " report" SDF :(t)" , /rmbr unchanged + filename.t, unchanged

type cmddef is toseq:seq.word

function infiles(c:cmddef) seq.word /rmbr if n.toseq.c < 5 /rmbr ∨ (toseq.c) sub 3 ∈ " shell " then" input " /rmbr else toseq.c << 4

function cmdlib(a:cmddef) word (toseq.a) sub 3

function >1(a:cmddef, b:cmddef) ordering /rmbr(toseq.a) sub 2 >1 (toseq.b) sub 2

Function makeScriptCore(/rmbr input:seq.file /rmbr, builddir:seq.word /rmbr, format:word /rmbr, hashes:seq.file /rmbr) seq.word /rmbr for allfile = empty:set.lineinfo /rmbr, defs = empty:set.cmddef /rmbr, f ∈ breakparagraph.input do if f sub 1 ∈ " # " then next(allfile, defs) /rmbr else let aa = substitute(f, " +$build " , builddir), /rmbr if aa sub 1 ∈ " define " then next(allfile, defs + cmddef( if n.aa = 3 then aa + aa sub 2 else aa))/rmbr else let find = lookup(defs, cmddef( " define " + aa sub 1))/rmbr assert not. isempty.find report" command /em :(aa sub 1) is not defined. " , /rmbr next( allfile + tolineinfo(aa, builddir, find sub 1)/rmbr, defs) { build graph } /rmbr for arcs1 = empty:seq.arc.filename, line ∈ toseq.allfile /rmbr do let tail = (output.line) sub 1 /rmbr for more = arcs1, fn ∈ output.line << 1 /rmbr do more + arc(fn, tail), /rmbr for arcs2 = more, fn ∈ input.line do arcs2 + arc(tail, fn), /rmbr arcs2 let g = newgraph.arcs1 /rmbr let unchanged = asset. unchanged.hashes let changed = asset. sinks.g /rmbr \ unchanged /rmbr \ asset.[ filename(builddir + " shell.lib " )] let outdated = reachable( complement.g, toseq.changed)/rmbr \ changed for changelist = "" , n ∈ toseq.changed /rmbr do changelist + fullname.n /rmbr for unchangelist = "" , n ∈ toseq.unchanged /rmbr do unchangelist + fullname.n /rmbr let acc2 = " set /sp-e /br :( $$) changelist /nsp = :( dq.changelist) /br unchangelist /nsp = :( dq.unchangelist) /br for f in $changelist $unchangedlist; do /br :( $$) if /sp ! /sp[/sp-f $f /sp]/sp; then /br :( $$) echo :( dq. " File $f does not exist. " ) ; exit 1 /br :( $$) fi /br :( $$) done /br :( $$) if /sp[[/sp-z $makehash /sp]]; then " for acc = acc2 + " /br # remove outdated files " , dated ∈ toseq.outdated /rmbr do acc + " /br rm /sp-f " + fullname.dated /rmbr let subg = subgraph(g, outdated), /rmbr if format ∉ " script " then for debugtxt = "" , a ∈ if format ∈ " full " then toseq.arcs.g else toseq.arcs.subg /rmbr do debugtxt + " + :(tail.a) + :(head.a)" , /rmbr debugtxt else for cmds = "" , d ∈ toseq.defs /rmbr do if cmdlib.d ∈ " shell " then cmds /rmbr else let cmd = (toseq.d) sub 2 /rmbr let exe = cmdlib.d, /rmbr let rest = if n.toseq.d < 4 then [cmd] else[(toseq.d) sub 4], /rmbr cmds /rmbr + " /br function :(cmd) /sp{/br :( $$) built/ /nsp :(exe) .lib :(rest) $@ /br if /sp[/sp-e tmp/error.html /sp]/sp; then /br :( $$) $tauopen tmp/error.html; exit 1 /br :( $$) fi /br :( $$) } " , createorder(subg, allfile, acc + cmds)/rmbr + " /br fi "

Function fullnames(s:seq.filename) seq.word /rmbr for acc = "" , fn ∈ s do acc + fullname.fn, /rmbr acc

function createorder(g:graph.arc.filename, defs:set.lineinfo, out:seq.word) seq.word /rmbr let sinks = sinks.g, /rmbr if isempty.sinks then assert isempty.nodes.g report" cycle in graph " , /rmbr out else for txt = out /rmbr, p ∈ if isempty.sinks then toseq.nodes.g else sinks do let b = lookup(defs, lineinfo([p], empty:seq.filename, "" , cmddef. "" )), /rmbr if isempty.b then txt /rmbr else let l = line.b sub 1, /rmbr txt /rmbr + ( if l sub 1 ∈ " define " then "" /rmbr else if cmdlib.def.b sub 1 ∈ " shell " then" /br :(/rmbr shellparameters( toseq.def.b sub 1 << 3 /rmbr, fullnames.input.b sub 1 /rmbr, fullnames.output.b sub 1 /rmbr, line.b sub 1)/rmbr)" else let l1 = if subseq(l, 2, 3) = " input: " then[l sub 1] + l << 3 /rmbr else l," /br echo making :((output.b sub 1) sub 1) /br :(l1)" ), createorder( subgraph(g, nodes.g \ asset.sinks)/rmbr, defs /rmbr, txt + " /br #------------------------------- " )

function shellparameters(/rmbr cmd:seq.word /rmbr, input:seq.word /rmbr, output:seq.word /rmbr, other:seq.word /rmbr) seq.word /rmbr if n.cmd = 1 then cmd + " /sp :(( dq + " /nsp " + input + dq))" /rmbr else for out = subseq(cmd, 1, 1)/rmbr, last = cmd sub 1 /rmbr, w ∈ cmd << 1 do if w ∈ " : " then next( out >> 1 /rmbr + if last ∈ " input " then input /rmbr else if last ∈ " output " then output /rmbr else extractValue(other, [last]))/rmbr, w else next(out + w, w), out

Function >1(a:UTF8, b:UTF8) ordering toseqbyte.a >1 toseqbyte.b

Function >1(a:filename, b:filename) ordering /rmbr name.a >alpha name.b /rmbr ∧ ext.a >alpha ext.b /rmbr ∧ dirpath.a >alpha dirpath.b
